listings.title: Front Desk and Activation Intern: Johannesburg
listings.description:
Are you naturally warm, engaging, and comfortable interacting with people from all walks of life? We’re looking for a Learning Community Front Desk Intern with exceptional interpersonal skills, a welcoming presence, and a professional attitude. You should be vibrant, respectful, and confident in creating positive first and lasting impressions.

This role requires emotional intelligence, cultural awareness, and the ability to remain composed under pressure. If you’re reliable, eager to learn, and thrive in a dynamic, people-centred environment, we’d love to hear from you!!

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and reskill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving digital world. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles across tech, creative and entrepreneurship industries.

We achieve this by:

Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand skills that will power the future.

Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

Building a lifelong, impactful community of professionals that supports them at all stages of their career journey. 

Our impact thus far:

Our impact thus far: 

 347k+ graduates since 2020 

 257k youth in work

31k youth starting own ventures 

60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs 

Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

Position: Front Desk and Activation Intern
Department: Learning Experience and Recruitment
Reports To: Learning Community Experience Specialist
Duration: 3 months
Location: ALX Hub, Johannesburg, South Africa
Time Commitment: 40 hours per week

The Front Desk and Activations Intern serves as the primary customer service representative for the ALX Hub, supporting the Learner Experience and Recruitment teams in creating a welcoming, engaging, and well-managed hub environment. You will be the first point of contact for our learners, alumni and visitors. This role blends traditional front desk responsibilities with learner support—ensuring every learner feels welcomed, guided, and cared for throughout their journey with us.

This role is vital in maintaining communication and the interface between learners and the organisation. The intern will provide support for hub events, daily communication and nudges as well as learner led and recruitment activities within the hub, providing continuity and retention of learners across all programs.

Specific Responsibilities

Front Desk and Hub Operations Duties:

Greet learners, alumni, guests, and visitors with warmth and professionalism.

Create, send and answer emails and walk-in inquiries.

Manage front desk operations, including sign-in registers and scheduling.

Maintain a clean, organised, and welcoming reception area.

Support tour and hub visits and information provision for Hub navigation.

Identify opportunities to connect visitors with relevant programs.

Conduct weekly hub walkthroughs and stock takes, reporting any issues or supply needs to Learner Experience Specialist.

Support the planning and delivery of hub activities, events, and learner engagement initiatives.

Promote upcoming hub activities and recruitment events, and assist with outreach and inquiries from prospective learners.

Support learner-led activities within the hub.

Learner and Recruitment Support Duties:

Assist with basic technical support for learners on LMS.

Assist learners with general queries about programs, schedules, and resources.

Provide guidance on registration, onboarding, and program processes.

Help direct learners to the right staff members or support services.

Offer encouragement and support to ensure learners feel confident and engaged.

Promote upcoming hub activities and recruitment events, and assist with outreach and managing inquiries from prospective learners.

Administrative Support:

Support the team with clerical tasks such as data entry.

Assist in coordinating and setting up events, workshops, or learner activities when required.

Prepare and distribute communication materials (notices, reminders, etc).

Skill Requirements - Essential

Welcoming, friendly, and approachable personality.

Currently enrolled in an ALX program or a graduate.

Strong academic performance and professional presentation.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Professional appearance and demeanour suitable for front-desk.

Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse visitors.

Basic computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and email systems.

Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a busy environment.

Ability to handle conflict, remain calm and professional under pressure.

Reliability and punctuality for a consistent Hub presence.

Cultural sensitivity and ability to work with diverse cultures.

Skill Requirements - Preferable

Strong problem-solving skills for handling learner and visitor inquiries and challenges.

Proactive mindset and willingness to take initiative.

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Employment Type

This role is an Internship position

listings.title: ALG Head of Impact
listings.description:
Are you a rigorous impact leader who can build trusted evidence systems at scale? Do you know how to combine world-class evaluation methods with the speed and pragmatism of a high-growth organization? Are you equally comfortable discussing RCTs, sampling, confidence intervals, and causal inference as you are working with product, data, fundraising, and executive teams to turn evidence into better decisions, stronger donor confidence, and more powerful learner outcomes? Do you want to help build one of the most trusted, scalable impact engines in education and workforce development?

About The African Leadership Group (ALG)

The African Leadership Group is a family of mission-aligned institutions building one of the world’s most ambitious pipelines of ethical, entrepreneurial talent. Founded by Fred Swaniker in 2004, ALG has spent over two decades creating education and career pathways that identify overlooked potential, develop it through applied learning, and connect it to real opportunity -- from African Leadership Academy’s early leadership development, to African Leadership University’s mission-driven higher education, to ALX’s high-scale workforce training. Across this ecosystem, ALG is working toward a bold mission: developing 3 million leaders by 2035. To date, the Group has raised more than $1.7 billion in philanthropic support, graduated 373,000+ leaders across 50+ countries, supported the development of 10,000+ ventures, and demonstrated that high-quality, career-connected education can change trajectories at scale.

Role Summary

ALX and the broader African Leadership Group (ALG) are entering a new phase of growth. We have demonstrated the ability to scale rapidly, reach learners across the continent, and generate meaningful early outcomes. 

We are looking for a Head of Impact to build the rigorous, scalable, externally credible impact engine that will support ALG’s next chapter. This role will lead the evolution of our Impact function from a reporting and monitoring function into a world-class evidence, learning, validation, and impact intelligence capability.

The mandate is ambitious: to make ALG one of the most trusted organizations in education and workforce development for impact quality, transparency, data integrity, and external validation.

This leader will own the systems, methods, partnerships, collateral, and team needed to make our impact claims audit-ready, donor-ready, decision-ready, and, where appropriate, publication-ready. They will help the organization move beyond short-term placement statistics toward a deeper understanding of income lift, economic mobility, career progression, promotions, entrepreneurship, household uplift, family support, resilience, and long-term opportunity.

The right candidate will bring deep expertise in rigorous impact methodology, including RCTs, quasi-experimental methods, longitudinal studies, sampling, survey design, and causal inference, while also being able to operate in ALG’s fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. This is not a slow academic research role, nor is it a traditional M&E compliance role. It is a senior builder role for someone who can bring rigor without rigidity, structure without bureaucracy, and external credibility without slowing down innovation.

Specific Responsibilities

Build the evidence and trust architecture

Build the trust infrastructure for ALG’s next phase of scale: the methodologies, systems, validation partnerships, dashboards, governance, and public-facing evidence needed to make our impact claims credible under scrutiny.

Develop and own ALG’s impact methodology, including approaches to data collection, verification, sampling, extrapolation, attribution, contribution, confidence intervals, error margins, data quality, and limitations

Define the standards for what ALG can claim internally, what can be shared with donors, what requires caveats, and what is ready for external publication or independent validation.

Move ALG’s impact narrative beyond short-term placement statistics to include income lift, economic mobility, promotions, entrepreneurship, household uplift, family support, resilience, and long-term career progression.

Strengthen internal alignment around core impact definitions, metrics, data sources, reporting standards, and evidence thresholds, ensuring leadership, fundraising, product, and program teams are working from a single source of truth.

Lead rigorous evaluation and external validation

Design and lead a rigorous research and evaluation agenda, including RCTs, quasi-experimental studies, tracer studies, longitudinal research, employer studies, learner surveys, and mixed-methods evaluation.

Identify which research methods are appropriate for different programs, geographies, and questions — balancing gold-standard rigor with the practical realities of a fast-moving, scaled organization.

Build partnerships with credible external validators, researchers, economists, evaluation firms, academic institutions, and research labs to strengthen public and donor confidence in ALG’s impact.

Create a roadmap for when, where, and how ALG should pursue external validation, publish findings, commission independent evaluations, or subject its methodology to external review.

Ensure external validation efforts are directly connected to organizational learning, fundraising, program improvement, and public trust, not research for research’s sake.

Build impact intelligence systems and data quality

Partner with Data, Product, Engineering, Learning, Community, and Operations teams to embed impact measurement across the learner journey, from registration and baselines through program completion, transition into work, long-term outcomes, and alumni progression.

Strengthen data pipelines and verification systems across surveys, platform data, CRM tools, employer feedback, relationship manager inputs, alumni updates, financial or KYC rails, LinkedIn/digital trace data, and other relevant sources.

Build QA and governance systems that make impact data audit-ready, including audit trails, anomaly detection, dashboard health checks, data dictionaries, internal controls, documentation, and clear ownership for core metrics.

Ensure dashboards and data products are reliable, donor-friendly, methodologically clear, and able to distinguish between actuals, estimates, projections, and externally validated outcomes.

Work with technical teams to make impact data useful for decision-making, not just reporting, including predictive insights, segmentation, learner support interventions, and program improvement.

Turn evidence into learning, fundraising, and thought leadership

Develop donor-facing and public-facing collateral that clearly explains ALG’s evidence standards, collection methods, verification layers, sampling approach, extrapolation logic, audit protocols, and methodological limitations.

Partner with Fundraising and Partnerships to create credible impact assets for major donors, institutional funders, governments, employers, and strategic partners.

Produce or oversee white papers, methodology briefs, board materials, impact reports, donor evidence packs, and thought leadership on ALG’s approach to economic mobility, AI-era workforce development, youth employment, entrepreneurship, household uplift, and durable career resilience.

Lead a practical learning agenda that identifies the highest-value questions ALG must answer to improve outcomes, strengthen funder confidence, and scale responsibly.

Translate impact data into actionable insights that improve learner experience, program design, community support, employer engagement, fundraising, and long-term outcomes.

Lead and evolve the Impact Team

Lead and strengthen the Impact Team, building a culture that is rigorous, fast, transparent, ethical, analytical, and deeply connected to organizational strategy.

Build the team’s capabilities across impact evaluation, data quality, analytics, survey design, storytelling, research partnerships, donor collateral, and product collaboration.

Create operating rhythms that ensure the Impact Team is proactive, responsive, and embedded across the organization rather than functioning as a retrospective reporting unit.

Serve as a senior advisor to leadership on impact claims, data risks, evidence quality, external validation, donor diligence, and public communication.

Bring rigor without rigidity, structure without bureaucracy, and external credibility without slowing down ALG’s entrepreneurial pace.

Skill Requirements - Essential

10+ years of relevant experience in impact evaluation, applied research, economics, workforce development, education outcomes, labor market analytics, social impact strategy, data science, or a related field.

Deep expertise in rigorous impact methodology, including RCTs, quasi-experimental methods, causal inference, longitudinal studies, tracer studies, sampling, survey design, mixed-methods research, and evaluation design.

Experience designing, managing, commissioning, or partnering on external evaluations with academic researchers, research organizations, foundations, multilaterals, or independent evaluators.

Strong understanding of education-to-employment, workforce development, economic mobility, youth employment, entrepreneurship, income lift, household outcomes, or labor market transitions.

Strong data fluency, including comfort working with dashboards, data pipelines, data warehouses, CRM systems, survey platforms, product analytics, and data quality processes.

Ability to translate complex research and methodology into clear, credible materials for donors, boards, executives, governments, employers, and public audiences.

Experience working cross-functionally with product, data, engineering, operations, learning, fundraising, communications, and senior leadership teams.

Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce methodology notes, donor briefs, board materials, impact reports, white papers, and thought leadership.

Excellent judgment on evidence quality, including when to use gold-standard evaluation methods, when to use faster pragmatic approaches, and how to communicate uncertainty or limitations.

Proven ability to lead teams, build systems, manage ambiguity, and operate effectively in fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments.

Strong ethical grounding around data privacy, consent, responsible AI, equity, transparency, and the risks of overclaiming impact.

A bias toward action, paired with the discipline to build systems that are credible, auditable, and trusted.

Skill Requirements - Preferable

Experience at or with organizations such as J-PAL, IDInsight, Opportunity Insights, Jobs for the Future, Burning Glass / Lightcast, One Acre Fund, GiveDirectly, 60 Decibels, IPA, MDRC, Mathematica, World Bank, major foundations, or high-growth social enterprises.

Advanced degree in economics, public policy, statistics, education, data science, development studies, social science, or another quantitative or evaluation-focused field.

Experience in Africa or other emerging markets, especially in education, skilling, workforce development, entrepreneurship, youth employment, or economic mobility.

Experience building or scaling an impact, MERL, research, data, evidence, or learning function inside a growing organization.

Experience supporting major fundraising, donor diligence, institutional reporting, or evidence-building for large philanthropic, bilateral, multilateral, or government funders.

Experience with labor market data, employer-reported outcomes, wage data, financial transaction data, LinkedIn or other digital trace data, and/or longitudinal learner tracking.

Familiarity with AI-enabled data systems, product analytics, data governance, technology-enabled monitoring and evaluation, or impact intelligence platforms.

Experience publishing or contributing to externally credible research, white papers, field-building reports, policy briefs, or public-facing thought leadership.

Experience translating evaluation findings into program design, learner support interventions, product improvements, or strategic decisions.

Familiarity with workforce credentials, skills-based hiring, digital skilling, AI-era labor market shifts, or education-to-employment pathways.

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

This role requires strong self-management, proactive communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, cross-functional environment. The successful candidate should be comfortable working across teams and time zones, using digital collaboration tools, and maintaining momentum in a remote-first setting.

Disclaimer: ALX Africa does not charge fees or request payments at any stage of hiring. Be cautious of anyone claiming otherwise. Report suspicious activity to hiring@alxafrica.com

listings.title: Community Associate: Lagos
listings.description:

Are you highly organised and able to manage multiple activities with strong follow-through? Are you people-oriented and comfortable engaging learners and alumni, managing community platforms, and creating a welcoming, active environment both online and offline? Are you data-driven, able to track engagement, participation, and feedback, and use insights to improve community execution and experience? Have you supported partnerships, events, or initiatives that generated value or revenue for a community or organisation? Are you proactive, reliable, and excited to help build and sustain one of the most vibrant tech talent communities in Africa? If so, this might just be the role for you. 

About ALX Africa 

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers. 

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors.  Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

 Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

 257k youth in work

Role Summary 

The Community Associate is responsible for executing and supporting the day-to-day operations of ALX Nigeria’s community, ensuring a high-quality, consistent, and engaging experience for learners and alumni. 

Working closely with the Community Manager, this role focuses on bringing community programmes, events, and engagement initiatives to life. The Community Associate plays a critical role in ensuring that community systems operate effectively, members remain actively engaged, and the ALX Lagos hub functions as a vibrant and welcoming space. 

This role sits at the centre of community execution and member experience, supporting engagement, content capture, and grassroots activation while contributing to broader growth and brand objectives. The ideal candidate is highly organised, people-oriented, and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining strong attention to detail and energy. 

Specific Responsibilities 

In this role, you will: 

 Execute community programmes, events, and engagement initiatives in line with the Community Development Playbook. 

 Support the day-to-day operations of the ALX Lagos hub, ensuring the space is active, organised, and welcoming. 

 Coordinate logistics for community events, workshops, and meetups, including scheduling, setup, and participant management. 

Manage community communication channels, including responding to member inquiries, moderating platforms, and supporting engagement. 

Build and maintain strong relationships with learners, alumni, and ambassadors through consistent interaction and follow-up.

Support the ambassador and referral programme execution by coordinating activities and tracking participation.

Capture and support user-generated content (UGC) from community activities, including testimonials, event highlights, and learner stories.

Track community activity and engagement metrics, including attendance, participation, and feedback. 

Provide regular updates and reports on community activity to support performance tracking. 

Support partnerships and external engagements by coordinating logistics and ensuring smooth execution of joint activities.

Collaborate with Growth, Content, and Recruitment teams to ensure community initiatives align with broader campaigns and objectives. 

Skill Requirements - Essential 

 3–5 years of experience in community management, events, customer experience, or related roles. 

 Strong organisational and coordination skills with attention to detail. 

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. 

 Ability to engage and build relationships with diverse groups of people.

Experience coordinating events, programmes, or community initiatives.

Highly proactive with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.

Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. 

Proficiency in: 

Google Slides / PowerPoint 

Google Sheets / Excel 

Google Docs 

AI Tools 

BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar platforms. 

Skill Requirements - Preferable 

 Experience working in education, technology, or youth-focused environments.

Experience supporting ambassador or referral programmes. 

 Experience capturing content (photos, videos, testimonials) for digital platforms.

Familiarity with community platforms, CRM tools, or engagement systems.

Person Specification/Attributes 

 Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges. 

 Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others. 

 Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey. 

 Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond. 

 Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger. 

 Energy and Presence: brings life to spaces and interactions 

 Reliability: consistently delivers high-quality execution 

 People Orientation: enjoys engaging and supporting others 

Attention to Detail: ensures smooth and professional experiences 

What Success Looks Like 

 Community programmes and events run smoothly with strong participation and engagement. 

 The ALX Lagos hub operates as a vibrant, well-utilised, and welcoming space.

Learners and alumni feel supported, connected, and actively engaged.

Community engagement levels remain high across both online and offline platforms. 

A strong volume of user-generated content is captured from community activities.

Community initiatives are executed consistently and contribute to broader growth and brand objectives. 

Employment Type 

This role is a full-time position

Do you want your work to directly support a mission that is unlocking tech careers for millions of young Africans? If so, then this might just be the role for you.

Role Summary

ALX Africa is looking for a Data Scientist to join our Business Intelligence team. You will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics that turn data into insight across the organisation. Working closely with the BI team and stakeholders, you will write production SQL and Python, design reliable reporting pipelines, and help shape how the business measures and acts on its data. This is a remote role within Africa, working African time zones.

Specific Responsibilities

Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports that give stakeholders clear, timely visibility into performance.

Write and optimise SQL and Python to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.

Partner with stakeholders to understand their questions, define metrics, and translate requirements into analytics that drive decisions.

Ensure data quality and accuracy through validation, de-duplication, and reconciliation of reporting outputs.

Document analyses and reporting logic, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Skill Requirements - Essential

A degree or equivalent qualification in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

3-5 years of hands-on experience in a data science, analytics, or business intelligence role.

Strong, demonstrable SQL skills, including writing complex queries and working with large datasets.

Proficiency in Python for data analysis, manipulation, and automatio

Proven experience building dashboards and reports in tools like QuickSight, Metabase, or Power BI.

A strong eye for data quality and accuracy, with the ability to communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Skill Requirements - Preferable

Dedicated business intelligence experience, including ownership of reporting or analytics in a previous role.

Experience with data engineering or building and maintaining data pipelines.

API integration and automation experience would be a plus.

Exposure to statistical modelling, forecasting, or machine learning techniques.

Experience working in a remote, distributed team across multiple time zones.

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Rigour: A commitment to accuracy, attention to detail, and getting the numbers right.

Employment Type

This role is a full-time position

Preferred Time Zones

The preferred time zones are SAST / CAT / EAT (GMT +2 to GMT +3)

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential. As an employee, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capability & attain certifications to reflect your growth as an individual.

listings.description:

Do you have the commercial instincts to prospect, qualify, and close with senior buyers, while simultaneously building the assets and tracking systems the team needs to scale? If so, this might just be the role for you.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Sales Manager who can drive revenue growth by building, managing, and closing a strong pipeline of B2B deals for ALX Enterprise, our corporate training business, and closing other revenue-generating partnerships that support the long-term sustainability of ALX’s mission.

About ALX Enterprise

ALX Enterprise is our corporate training business. We help ambitious organisations build the leaders and workforce they need through executive education, leadership development, and digital and AI skills programmes. Our clients include pan-African banks, telcos, FMCG and energy companies across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Rwanda, Morocco and Côte d'Ivoire. Revenue from ALX Enterprise directly helps sustain ALX's mission.

Visit our website enterprise.alxafrica.com to learn more about how we transform corporate team performance with measurable results.

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Sales Manager, your mandate is to close deals and generate revenue to contribute to our organisation's financial sustainability. In this role, you will be responsible for hands-on sales activity, building and converting a strong sales pipeline, and establishing revenue-generating partnerships. You will report to the VP, ALX Enterprise.

A key priority of the role is to develop and scale corporate training as a new and strategic growth lever for ALX. This requires a builder mindset, with the ability to originate opportunities, structure offers, and close deals in an evolving space. Beyond corporate training, you will also identify and close additional revenue-generating partnerships and commercial collaborations that contribute directly to the sustainability of ALX’s mission.

Specific Responsibilities

Revenue Generation and Pipeline Ownership

Close new and expansion revenue against a quarterly and annual target.

Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals from prospecting to signed contract. Run discovery with CEOs, CHROs, CPOs and L&D heads to understand their strategy and leadership gaps, and work through procurement to close.

Shape proposals and pricing with the Design and Delivery teams so deals are winnable and protect our margin targets.

Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities in a CRM with clear pipeline visibility and forecasting

Lead responses to selected public-sector RFPs and B2G opportunities.

Business development and activations

Plan and run Business Development activations: experiential events, executive roundtables, webinars, thought leadership and targeted outbound.

Turn activations into pipeline, with clear targets for meetings booked, opportunities created and conversion to sales.

Build and work target account lists by market and sector.

Partnerships

Build referral and channel partnerships that source qualified deals.

Identify, structure and close revenue partnerships beyond corporate training, such as sponsorships, access-fee coverage and other commercial collaborations.

Ensure strong alignment between revenue generation and ALX’s mission.

Sales infrastructure and team

Improve the sales playbook, collateral and process as you learn what wins.

Coach the current sellers, run the sales rhythm, support our sales boot camps, and hire and onboard the next seller when the numbers justify it.

Bring win/loss patterns, pricing signals and offer gaps back to the VP and delivery leads.

Client success

Define the client success scorecard: retention, expansion, satisfaction and on-time renewals.

Own a clean sales-to-delivery handover and an account-planning rhythm for top clients.

Skill Requirements - Essential

8+ years of B2B sales or consulting in enterprise services: L&D, consulting, HR or ed-tech, professional services, or similar, with 3+ years leading people or a commercial function.

A track record of hitting, and ideally exceeding, revenue targets on complex, six-figure deals with C-suite or HR leadership. 

Experience selling services, learning, consulting or HR solutions to senior HR and business leaders.

Experience building sales pipelines from scratch, with forecasting discipline

Evidence of creating and converting demand through multiple sales channels, including events, partnerships, outbound or thought leadership.

Strong network or experience selling into large companies within Africa and beyond, and comfort working across multiple markets

listings.title: Entrepreneurship Development Manager: Johannesburg
listings.description:
Are you a natural relationship-builder who turns founder and freelancer stories into revenue, partnerships, and brand impact? We’re looking for an Entrepreneurship Development Manager with the commercial instincts, ecosystem network, and programme leadership to grow ALX Ventures’ presence in South Africa.

This role requires strong business development, stakeholder management, and programme leadership skills, and the ability to operate independently across revenue, partnerships, community, and academy delivery. If you’re a self-starter who can build a brand, drive revenue, and own outcomes end-to-end, we’d love to hear from you!!

Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our learners for in-demand roles.

We achieve this by:

Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech, creative and entrepreneurship skills that will power the future.

Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and creators through challenging, real-world coursework.

Building a lifelong, impactful community of professionals and entrepreneurs that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Role Summary

ALX South Africa is looking for an Entrepreneurship Development Manager who will own the strategic growth, revenue generation, and ecosystem positioning of ALX Ventures in South Africa, including end-to-end leadership of the Founder Academy and Freelancer Academy.

Based at the Johannesburg hub, the manager will act as ALX Ventures’ primary relationship-builder in South Africa — driving revenue and strategic partnerships, building the B2B ecosystem through corporate and investor events, growing the B2C community through founder and freelancer experiences, deepening alumni engagement by uncovering and sharing their stories, and owning the Founder and Freelancer Academies end-to-end across the full programme lifecycle, from recruitment and activation through to engagement, graduation, and alumni integration.

Success in this role will be measured by:

Revenue generated through partnerships, and programme sales

Growth and quality of the B2B ecosystem network, including corporate, investor, and partner relationships

Community growth and engagement across B2C founder and freelancer events

Founder and Freelancer Academy conversion, activation, retention, and graduation rates

Depth, reach, and impact of alumni engagement and story-led brand building

By combining revenue generation, strategic partnerships, ecosystem and community building, and end-to-end academy ownership, the manager will grow ALX Ventures’ brand, footprint, and impact across the South African entrepreneurship landscape. As a Functional Specialist and non-people manager, the role holder will translate this mandate into a robust operational plan and execute it with a high degree of independence — proactively managing upwards, flagging issues early, and proposing solutions — while ALX Ventures leadership sets the broader strategy.

Specific Responsibilities

Revenue Generation & Business Development

Own revenue generation for ALX Ventures South Africa, including programme fees, and partner-funded contracts

Identify and convert new revenue opportunities through corporate partnerships, sponsorships, and grant-funded programmes

Track revenue performance against targets, and report progress, risks, and opportunities to leadership

Build and manage a pipeline of paying clients, partners, and programme participants to sustain and grow revenue

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Building (B2B Events)

Build and manage a network of corporate, investor, and ecosystem partners to support ALX Ventures’ strategic goals in South Africa

Design and deliver B2B ecosystem events — investor showcases, corporate partner sessions, and ecosystem convenings — that position ALX Ventures as a key player in the South African entrepreneurship landscape

Negotiate and manage partnership agreements that create tangible value for learners, alumni, and the business

Community Building (B2C Events)

Design and execute a community-building strategy and calendar of B2C events — masterclasses, meetups, and demo days — for founders and freelancers

Build a vibrant, engaged community of current learners and alumni across Johannesburg and virtually for those outside the city

Collaborate with marketing and cross-functional teams to grow community reach, engagement, and brand affinity

Founder & Freelancer Academy Management (End-to-End)

Own the Founder and Freelancer Academies end-to-end, from recruitment and conversion through activation, engagement, and graduation

Manage recruitment, activation, retention, and graduation targets, adapting strategy to the different needs of FA and FLA learners

Continuously improve programme delivery to ensure a high-quality learner experience and strong outcomes

Manage relationships with facilitators, mentors, and coaches who support the academies

Monitor learner data throughout the programme lifecycle to proactively identify and address risks to conversion, activation, or graduation

ALX Ventures Brand Building in South Africa

Grow the ALX Ventures brand and reputation across the South African entrepreneurship ecosystem

Represent ALX Ventures at speaking engagements, media opportunities, and public platforms to build brand visibility and credibility

Partner with the marketing team to develop content, campaigns, and messaging that reflect ALX Ventures’ impact, voice, and positioning

Data Monitoring & Reporting

Monitor and analyse programme and revenue metrics — recruitment, activation, retention, graduation, and revenue — to identify areas for improvement

Evaluate the success of programmes, partnerships, and events, and recommend strategies to improve impact and return on investment

Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of programme performance, partnerships, and community engagement for reporting and decision-making

Prepare regular performance updates and reports for leadership and key stakeholders

Use data and dashboards to track progress against targets, and escalate risks or blockers proactively

Act as the primary point of contact for programme alumni, building trusted, ongoing relationships as key ecosystem stakeholders

Proactively uncover, document, and share alumni success stories to fuel marketing, brand, and fundraising efforts

Design and implement alumni engagement strategies, including events, mentorship opportunities, and peer networks

Encourage alumni participation in community events, masterclasses, and mentorship for current learners

Support alumni in accessing opportunities such as partnerships, clients, funding, and collaborations, and track engagement to grow long-term ecosystem value

Skill Requirements - Essential

6+ years of experience within the entrepreneurship ecosystem, including startup support, incubation, acceleration, or venture-building environments

Experience building and managing strategic partnerships with corporates, investors, or ecosystem stakeholders, including designing and delivering B2B events

Experience managing end-to-end programmes or cohorts, from recruitment through to graduation, ideally within an accelerator, incubator, or education environment

Experience building and growing communities, including designing and delivering in-person and virtual events

Strong stakeholder management experience, including engaging alumni, partners, and senior stakeholders to build relationships and surface opportunities

Skill Requirements - Preferable

Proven experience generating revenue through programme sales, or partnership-driven business development

Experience coaching or supporting founders and freelancers, ideally within the African entrepreneurship ecosystem

Familiarity with the South African funding landscape, including corporate ESD/B-BBEE, DFI, and grant-funded programme models

Experience using CRM systems, learner management systems (LMS), or data dashboards to track programme and revenue performance

Prior experience building or scaling a brand within a fast-paced, mission-driven organisation

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Commercially Minded: Sees revenue and partnership opportunities everywhere, and translates relationships into tangible business outcomes.

Relationship Builder: Builds trust quickly with founders, partners, investors, and alumni, and sustains those relationships over time.

Strategic Thinker: Able to translate a broad mandate into a clear operational plan, and to prioritise across revenue, partnerships, and programme delivery.

Strong Communicator: Comfortable representing ALX Ventures across corporate, investor, media, and community settings with a confident, professional presence.

Organised & Data-Informed: Able to track revenue, programme, and engagement metrics, and adapt strategy to improve outcomes.

This role is a full-time position.

This a hybrid role: work 3 days a week in the hub, with regular time in market for partner meetings, ecosystem events, and community engagements.

Track recruitment data and generate insights to optimize campaigns and processes.

Support initiatives that strengthen ALX’s presence in the youth ecosystem.

Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable campaign improvements.

Partner Success Manager

Reports to: Regional General Manager

Location: South Africa

Employment: 10-month contract | 1 October 2026 – 31 July 2027

Role Summary

The Partner Success Manager is responsible for the successful execution of partner agreements from signature through to completion.

This role owns the partner relationship while, critically, ensuring that everything agreed is translated into a clear delivery plan and executed to a high standard. The role will coordinate delivery across internal teams and external stakeholders, manage timelines and deliverables, track performance against agreed outcomes, and ensure partners receive consistent communication and reporting throughout the engagement.

This is an execution-heavy role: own the agreement, drive the delivery, manage the partner and ensure the outcomes are delivered.

Manage a portfolio of 1–3 partner relationships, depending on the size, complexity and strategic importance of each initiative. Larger, more complex partnerships will require deeper day-to-day programme management and stakeholder coordination, while smaller initiatives may allow the role to manage a broader portfolio.

The role will manage partnerships focused on talent and entrepreneurship outcomes, ensuring that participants move successfully through the agreed customer journey and that the partnership delivers measurable economic outcomes.

Typical Partnership Scope

The core journey is:

Recruitment & Selection → Skills → Work Readiness → Placement/ Self-employment → Retention & Progression → Monitor & Tracking

Depending on the partnership, this may also include an entrepreneurship pathway:

Recruitment & Selection → Skills → Business Readiness → Venture Development → Income / Business Growth Retention & Progression → Monitor & Tracking

The Partner Success Manager is responsible for ensuring the activities, stakeholders and deliverables required at each stage of the journey are coordinated and executed effectively.

This includes:

Recruitment & Selection: Coordinating agreed recruitment and selection activities to ensure the right participants are identified, selected and onboarded against programme requirements.

Skills: Ensuring participants are successfully enrolled, engaged and progressing through the agreed learning experience.

Work Readiness: Coordinating career preparation, professional skills, CV/profile development, interview preparation and other agreed readiness interventions.

Placement / Self-Employment: Driving the coordination of employer, recruitment, client and opportunity pipelines to support agreed employment, freelance, contract or self-employment outcomes.

Business Readiness: Where applicable, coordinating the support required to prepare participants to develop and operate viable businesses.

Venture Development: Where applicable, coordinating entrepreneurship support from venture development through to income generation and business growth.

Retention & Progression: Ensuring agreed post-placement or post-programme support, tracking and interventions are delivered to support sustained outcomes and progression.

Monitoring & Tracking: Maintaining accurate visibility of participant progress, programme milestones, deliverables and outcomes throughout the partnership, and ensuring data is available for reporting.

Partner Outcomes: Ensuring the partner has clear visibility of progress and that agreed impact and outcome targets are achieved, evidenced and communicated.

Specific Responsibilities

Own Partner Agreement Execution

Translate signed partner agreements into clear delivery plans, milestones, KPIs, timelines and accountabilities.

Ensure every contractual deliverable has a clear owner and is actively tracked through to completion.

Coordinate internal teams and external stakeholders to deliver agreed activities and outcomes.

Manage changes to scope, timelines or deliverables and ensure these are appropriately documented.

Identify delivery risks and gaps early and drive resolution.

Own programme close-out, ensuring all contractual deliverables and reporting requirements are completed.

Own the Participant / Beneficiary Journey

Coordinate delivery across the agreed journey — from Recruitment & Selection through Skills, Work Readiness, Placement / Self-Employment, Retention & Progression, through to Monitoring & Tracking.

Ensure handovers between each stage are clearly defined and effectively managed.

Track participant progression through the journey and identify bottlenecks, drop-off points and delivery gaps.

Work across recruitment, programme, operations, placement and other teams to ensure participants receive the agreed experience and support.

Where entrepreneurship forms part of the partnership, coordinate delivery across Business Readiness, Venture Development, Income / Business Growth and Retention & Progression.

Ensure participant and programme data is accurately captured throughout the journey.

 Manage Partner & Delivery, Stakeholders

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned partners.

Build strong, trusted relationships while maintaining clear accountability for agreed deliverables.

Establish appropriate meeting, communication and escalation rhythms with partners and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate employers, recruitment agencies, clients, ecosystem partners and other external stakeholders where required to deliver outcomes.

Communicate progress, challenges, risks and changes proactively.

Manage expectations and resolve issues before they escalate.

 Own Monitoring, Reporting & Outcomes

Maintain a clear view of programme performance against agreed milestones, KPIs and outcomes.

Track the conversion and progression of participants across the journey — from recruitment through to economic outcomes.

Produce accurate and timely partner reports, programme updates and performance reviews.

Ensure outcomes are supported by reliable data and evidence.

Identify underperformance and work with relevant teams to develop and implement corrective actions.

Capture lessons learned and use performance insights to improve programme execution.

 Drive Partner Success, Retention & Growth

Ensure partners have visibility of delivery, progress and impact throughout the engagement.

Build confidence through consistent execution, communication and delivery against commitments.

Identify opportunities to strengthen the partnership based on performance, outcomes and partner priorities.

Support renewals, extensions and future opportunities by demonstrating successful delivery and impact.

Feed delivery insights back into the Partnerships and Commercial teams to strengthen future proposals and partnership design.

100% of agreed deliverables completed on time

100% of active agreements have documented delivery plans, owners and timelines

All partner reporting was delivered accurately and on schedule

Delivery issues identified and addressed proactively

High partner satisfaction and strong renewal/extension rates

Clear internal accountability for every partner commitment

Skill Requirements

listings.title: Senior Learning Experience Designer
listings.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of creativity, systems thinking, and education? Have you led teams that turn abstract ideas into powerful, learner-centred programs? Are you skilled at translating complex industry insights into engaging curricula that scale globally? Do you find energy in managing projects from concept to launch while mentoring designers to deliver excellence? Are you passionate about building innovative learning experiences that shape the future of work and creativity across Africa? If so, then this might just be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and reskill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey. 

Our impact thus far:

347k+ graduates since 2020

257k youth in work

31k youth starting own ventures

60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

 Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

The Senior Learning Experience Designer manages a team of Learning Experience Designers, oversees the creation of high-quality curricula, and ensures all programs align with our learning principles and strategic goals. You will act as both a coach and a project manager: guiding the design team, setting up workflows, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining quality. You’ll collaborate with subject matter experts, industry partners, and internal teams to develop innovative programs in fast-growing fields, ensuring they are scalable, practical, and impactful.

Specific Responsibilities

Program & Curriculum Development

Oversee the design of new programs, ensuring learning experiences are practical, scalable, and industry-relevant.

Ensure curricula and assessments embody our learning design principles and align with the desired competencies.

Collaborate with industry subject matter experts and institutions to co-create cutting-edge program content.

Team Leadership & Project Management

Lead and coach Learning Experience Designers, providing feedback and professional development in instructional design, media integration, and data-informed storytelling.

Manage design workflows, sprints, and retrospectives to ensure smooth delivery.

Oversee staffing allocations, project plans, and delivery calendars.

Establish strong review processes for content quality, accessibility, and pedagogical rigour.

Contribute to internal learning initiatives and workshops that strengthen the learning design function organisation-wide.

Quality & Innovation

Ensure alignment with codified learning principles and institutional standards.

Incorporate learner, facilitator, and partner feedback into design iterations.

Experiment with new tools, technologies, and media formats (including AI) to enhance learner engagement and outcomes.

Drive a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across the design team.

Codify best practices, frameworks, and tools into playbooks and templates that enable consistent, high-quality design across programs.

Data & Insights

Use learner performance data, completion metrics, and feedback to iteratively improve course design and delivery.

Develop dashboards or reporting frameworks in partnership with the data team to track learning effectiveness, engagement, and assessment validity.

Advocate for evidence-based decision-making in program and content iterations.

Skill Requirements

Experience

Proven track record in instructional design, learning experience design, or curriculum development.
Experience leading teams of designers or educators, with strong coaching and mentorship abilities.

Demonstrated experience managing large-scale program development projects.

Experience working with or integrating AI-powered learning or assessment tools.

Beneficial: exposure to creative industries, digital media, or emerging technology fields.

Beneficial: Prior experience working in accredited or competency-based education programs is a plus.

Skills

Expertise in instructional design methods, curriculum frameworks, and learner-centred design.

Strong systems thinking and ability to design learning experiences that balance pedagogy, technology, and operations.

Strong project management skills (e.g., sprint planning, retrospectives, pipeline tracking).

Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with SMEs, partners, and cross-functional teams.

Ability to translate research and feedback into actionable program improvements.

Passion for innovation in learning, with comfort navigating ambiguity and complexity.

Familiarity with authoring tools (e.g. H5P) and learning management systems.

Strong storytelling, writing, and editing skills for creating engaging learning narratives.

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Employment Type

This is a full-time role.

Due to the considerable amount of virtual work and interaction with colleagues and customers across different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but working independently virtually. Self-driving to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential.

Role Summary

ALX Africa is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to grow enrollment in our training programs in Egypt. You will own the applicant funnel from first awareness to enrolled learner, build a brand that young Egyptians trust, and support the growth of our corporate training business. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy and you execute it, supported by your team, contractors, and agencies. The role is based in Cairo and reports to the General Manager, ALX Egypt.

Specific Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning: Develop the marketing strategy and the enrollment plan for each program intake, covering objectives, target audiences, channel mix, budget, and calendar. Localize our global strategy to the needs and behaviour of Egyptian youth, and build a trusted collaboration with our global marketing function.

Funnel Ownership & Growth: Own the applicant funnel from lead to enrolled learner. Improve conversion at every stage and the efficiency of acquisition, and report on performance against targets.

Campaign Execution: Plan and run growth campaigns across digital channels yourself, then bring in contractors, freelancers, and agencies to scale what works. Find creative ways to expand our reach online (content, social media, video).

Brand Building, Creative Direction & Content: Build a brand that young Egyptians trust. Set the creative direction for how ALX looks, sounds, and shows up in Egypt, in line with our global brand, and apply it consistently across every channel and touchpoint. Lead content and learner stories that create demand for our programs (for example learner-generated content, alumni stories, and organic social).

Offline & Community Marketing: Build brand awareness and generate leads through in-person experiences that delight our prospects and build buzz about our programs (for example campus activations, community events, and partner events), delivered in Arabic for the local market.

Partnerships: Identify, build, and manage partnerships with key stakeholders that amplify our brand and generate new leads (universities, youth networks, influencers, corporates).

Corporate Training Marketing: Partner with our corporate training team to build our brand with employers and generate demand for our B2B offerings through campaigns, content, and events.

Martech & Analytics: Own our marketing technology stack (CRM, marketing automation, analytics, ad platforms). Track and analyze key marketing metrics, draw insights to identify scalable acquisition channels, and act on them to grow the business.

Team Leadership: Lead and develop the marketing team, and manage contractors and agencies to deliver against plan.

Skill Requirements-Essential

6 to 8+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in B2C marketing, with a track record of owning growth targets and delivering against them.

A hands-on operator: proven ability to plan and run campaigns yourself across digital channels, and to lead agencies and contractors without depending on them to deliver.

Experience working for a start-up or similar fast-paced environment, or demonstrated proactivity, resourcefulness, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment.

Strong command of performance marketing, marketing technology, and analytics. Comfortable with numbers and able to make data-driven decisions.

Experience building a brand and directing creative work (briefing designers, video, and copy) that lands with a young audience.

Strong understanding of the 18 to 30 age bracket in Egypt. Strong knowledge of popular culture, social media and digital amplification, content and influencer marketing, demonstrated through campaigns targeting youth.

Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills in both English and Arabic, including delivering in-person events in Arabic.

Experience leading a team, or managing contractors and agencies, to deliver marketing outcomes.

Skill Requirements -  Preferable

Experience ideating, planning, and running branding and community events.

Experience in marketing and recruitment for training or education programs, and/or a top FMCG company.

Experience in B2B or corporate marketing.

Experience identifying, building, and managing partnerships. 

Person Specification/Attributes

Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.

Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.

Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.

Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Ownership: Treats the enrollment number as their own, and delivers with their own hands before asking others to.

Commercial mindset: Comfortable with numbers, budgets, and trade-offs, and makes decisions based on data.

Employment Type

This is a full-time hybrid role. Candidates must be based in Cairo and have the right to work in Egypt.

Preferred Time Zones

The preferred time zone is GMT +2 (Cairo).

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential. As an employee, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capability & attain certifications to reflect your growth as an individual.

About impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products—Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

We are growing our sales organisation to accommodate the increasing demand for our solution. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic sales person to own one of our top territories in the UK & Ireland.  You will have the opportunity to grow rapidly and gain exposure to new marketing technologies as we progress! As an Account Executive , you will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers. Strong consultative and analytical skills are important for successful navigation from solution demo, the definition of the scope and final contract. Be the face and name of impact.com to some of the most well-known brands worldwide.

Responsibilities:

Sell the product to the appropriate accounts and manage towards hitting a preset revenue target.

Generate pipeline by proactively sourcing opportunities within the designated territory.

Prepare & deliver world-class demos and value-based presentations.

Answer prospects’ questions about product value, uses, integrations, and implementation.

Pro-actively drive the process with a prospective client from initial prospecting to a signed contract and internal handoff.

Drive active engagement by all internal and external stakeholders necessary to close a deal.

Update SFDC daily with all relevant details needed to reflect business reality.

Does this sound like you:

Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience.

2+ years of closing experience as an AE

Experience within the marketing space

Must be a true hunter!

Trained in  MEDDPICC and value-based selling is a plus

Proven track record of over-achieving quota (top 10-20% of the company) 

Must be willing to work out of the London office 2x a week, at the minimum

Independent person with the desire to excel in a competitive and highly rewarding industry.

Strong communication, effective problem-solving, networking and presentation skills.

Proven track record of building territories and addressing client needs.

Experience handling objections at multiple levels of enterprise organisations.

Benefits and Perks: 

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.

Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.

A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.

Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.

Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.

Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

About impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. Your Role at Impact:

Impact's Data Platform Engineering team is looking for an Associate Data Platform Engineer ready to build real distributed systems skills on large-scale production data. Our platform powers analytics, ML, and data products at TB–PB scale using Scala, Python, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and BigQuery on GCP.

This is a foundational role for someone early in their career who wants to learn how serious data infrastructure is built and operated, with mentorship from experienced engineers and clear patterns to follow. You'll work within the Data Analytics Group (DAG) alongside Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists, though you won't own dbt models, metric definitions, or reporting. Our ideal candidate has strong programming and SQL fundamentals, genuine curiosity about how systems behave under load, and good judgement about when to ask for help.

The role reports to the Team Lead, Data Platform Engineering, and is based in Cape Town, hybrid, with two days per week in office.

The platform:

The platform has strong foundations: Scala and Spark pipelines processing TB-scale data, dozens of managed data connectors, Airflow on Astronomer for orchestration, a mature dbt transformation layer, and BigQuery as the core analytical warehouse. You'll also have room to shape the platform's next chapter: modernising parts of the compute stack, and building out governance frameworks, data contracts, SLOs, observability, cost management, and data quality monitoring within your domain.

What You'll Do:

Pipeline development: Build and extend batch and streaming pipeline components under guidance. Write clean, tested Scala and Python code. Add Spark transformation steps, build Airflow DAGs, and implement Kafka consumers with senior support.

Platform configuration: Configure platform components such as BigQuery tables, partitioning strategies, and Cloud Storage buckets with guidance.

Observability & data quality: Build monitoring dashboards and alerting for job success, latency, and pipeline health. Implement data quality checks to catch anomalies, schema violations, and missing data.

Operations & incident response: Shadow the on-call rotation, help investigate root causes, debug using logs, metrics, and traces, and maintain runbooks and operational documentation.

Security, governance & cost awareness: Follow least-privilege access, secrets management, and PII handling by default. Consider the cost and performance implications of your changes with guidance.

Collaboration & craft: Use AI coding assistants while holding the same quality and review standards. Participate in code reviews, pairing, and technical discussions, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.

Preferred Requirements:

1–3 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role

Working programming ability in Scala, Java, or Python, with an appetite to become strong in both Scala and Python

Solid SQL fundamentals: joins, aggregations, window functions, and an understanding of query behaviour

listings.description:
About impact.com:

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

We’re hiring a technical Associate Product Manager for the Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad — one of impact.com’s most foundational domains: how brands and partners define terms, commissions, lists, and contract workflows that power revenue on the platform.

You’ll partner closely with a Senior Product Manager and Engineering to ship customer value in a complex, data-heavy domain. This is not a “project coordinator” APM role. You’ll write crisp requirements fast, dig into how systems behave, use AI tools as part of how you work, and grow ownership quickly under structured coaching. Relative to a Product Manager role, the emphasis here is strong execution and learning velocity on a focused scope — with ownership and outcome accountability expanding as you prove out.

Time to value matters. Shape usable Markdown requirements quickly with AI. Speed with rigor is the bar.

Success looks like: clear requirements with short cycle time from ask → draft → eng-ready, strong eng partnership, reliable delivery on your slice, and rising fluency in how Contracting and Action Processing connect to other domains.

What You'll Do:

You’ll own focused feature slices with coaching from your Senior PM, with scope expanding as you prove out execution and judgment.

Feature execution & delivery

Drive feature development for Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad initiatives (e.g. terms/commission behaviors, list and audience rules, contract workflows, and customer-driven requests).

Write customer and business requirements (user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria) that engineers can build from without ambiguity.

Partner with Engineering through build: surface risks, blockers, and acceptance gaps early.

Write and iterate Markdown requirements that live adjacent to the GitHub repo (alongside eng context), and co-lead pre-spec and spec reviews — with short time from ambiguous ask to eng-ready draft.

Technical fluency & AI-native working

Build working understanding of how AP and Contracting systems behave: data flows, edge cases, dependencies, and failure modes.

Use AI tools and agents as part of your daily craft to compress cycle time — drafting specs, synthesizing research, exploring prototypes, testing edge cases, and accelerating analysis — then validate outputs yourself. The point is faster time to a good requirement, not longer polish loops.

Get comfortable reading technical context (APIs, schemas, logs, tickets, eng design notes) enough to ask sharp questions and write better requirements.

Protect engineering focus: clear definition of ready, early pushback on late scope changes, and avoiding rework from unclear requirements.

Squad partnership & operational excellence

Keep a clear, healthy backlog for your scope (ticket clarity, prioritization hygiene, meeting facilitation, and request triage).

Sequence and clarify work in partnership with your Senior PM and Engineering leads.

Facilitate working sessions with Engineering, Design, Customer Success / Technical Services, and adjacent PMs.

Hold regular alignment touchpoints with Product and Engineering leads to keep priorities clear.

Roadmap, go-to-market & stakeholders

Contribute to clear communication of the squad’s planned roadmap within your scope.
