listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

We are hiring a senior Generalist Engineer for our Research & Development Team who can own problems end to end and deliver complete production systems, not just components. This is a broad, high-ownership role for an engineer who can operate across software, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, and, where useful, machine learning, moving from vague problem statements to clear designs, robust implementations, reliable deployment, and effective operation in production.

Success in this role requires strong first-principles thinking, sound technical judgment, deep debugging ability, and the willingness to work across boundaries to get the job done. We are looking for a true engineering generalist: someone who reduces complexity, improves reliability and performance, and treats ML as one tool among many rather than a default answer.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and build production-grade systems that are reliable, scalable, and observable.

Own systems end-to-end: problem → design → data → implementation → deployment → operations.

Work across application services, distributed systems, infrastructure, data pipelines, and ML systems

Debug complex production issues across multiple layers

Make engineering trade-offs grounded in first principles

Improve performance, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency

Contribute to architecture and technical direction

Write maintainable code and documentation

Raise the engineering bar

Machine Learning as Part of the Role

Frame problems correctly: when to use ML vs deterministic systems

Work with data end-to-end

Train, evaluate, and iterate on models

Build reproducible pipelines

Deploy models and monitor performance, drift, and cost

Debug system + model failures

What We're Looking For

Strong CS fundamentals (DSA, OS, networking, distributed systems)

Solid probability and statistics

Experience building production systems at scale

Ability to move across languages (Go, Java, Python, Rust, SQL)

Understanding of system behavior under load and failure

Comfort with Linux, containers, Kubernetes

Strong debugging skills

Ability to reason using invariants and failure modes

Data systems, streaming systems, ML infrastructure, performance optimization

What We Value

Ownership over problems

Simplicity over complexity

Curiosity about internals

Robust design thinking

Clear communication

What Success Looks Like

Deliver working production systems from ambiguous problems

Apply ML only when needed

Build reliable, scalable systems

Reduce complexity

Earn trust in technical judgment

If you are a builder, a systems thinker, and a technologist who loves exploring what’s next, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Moniepoint.

What we can offer you

Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

Our interview process is designed to be thoughtful, transparent, and candidate-friendly, allowing you to showcase your strengths while getting to know us better:

Initial Conversation: A brief introductory call with our recruiter to learn more about your background, career goals, and to share insights about the role and our team.

Technical Assessment: A practical, take-home assessment follow by a discussion with an interviewer on a call.

System Design Interview: A focused session with our Engineering Team, where we'll explore system design, architecture, and problem-solving approaches.

Final Interview: A combined technical and behavioural conversation with a member of our Executive Team, aimed at understanding your alignment with our values, vision, and culture

listings.title: Product Design Manager - Design System
listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About the role 

Designing for money means designing for trust. Our customers are shop owners, traders and entrepreneurs, and many are new to digital products. They work on low-end devices and unreliable networks, where one confusing screen can cost them a sale. Your team's work has to hold up for them, whatever their ability or device. You make sure it does. 

As a Design Manager, you'll lead a small team of product designers and be accountable for everything they ship: its quality, how it works as one product, and the results it drives for our customers and the business. Your team works either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. 

It is a hands-on role: you build the systems the team works within and step into the hardest problems yourself. 

What you'll do 

Set the design direction for your area, turn it into plans with milestones and measurable outcomes, and make the case for it to senior leaders in customer and business terms. Work with product partners so every designer begins from a clear, well-framed brief, and push back early when one isn't ready. 

Keep each customer journey whole across teams, and resolve conflicting designs before they launch. 

Run critique and design reviews against a definition of done that includes accessibility, and stay close enough to the work that nothing reaches customers below the bar. Decide what must be tested with customers before build and what can ship and be measured after, and plan that validation into delivery with success metrics defined up front. Make sure journeys use the design system, with market and product variations handled inside it rather than as one-off rebuilds. Plan and staff system contributions like any other project.

Build trusted partnerships with product and engineering, so design shapes what gets built, and design and engineering stay in step through build. 

Hire well, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and build a growth path for each designer. 

Bring AI tools into the team's design process, model effective and responsible use in your own work, and build that fluency across the team. 

What you'll need to succeed 

10+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio of shipped work across mobile and web that shows the problem, your decisions and the results. 

3+ years of experience managing product designers, including hiring, coaching and career development. 

Experience setting design direction for a product area and leading a team to deliver it. Experience running a design quality practice, such as critique, design reviews and a definition of done, that raised the quality of shipped work. 

Experience building shared patterns or templates adopted across teams, products or markets. Experience shipping accessible, inclusive products for people with disabilities, people new to digital products and people on limited devices and connectivity. 

Experience using AI tools in design work and building that fluency across a team. 

Nice to have 

Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome. 

What you will get:

A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.

Career growth opportunities.

A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.

Competitive compensation and benefits.

Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

What to expect in the hiring process 

Recruiter conversation. Your background, what you want next, and practical details. 2. Case study review. Walk a design leader through one or two case studies in depth: one from your own work, one from a team you led. 

Leadership challenge. Work through a product and team problem live with two design leaders. 

Final interview. A conversation with the hiring manager.

Why Join Us

Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.

Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.

What to expect in the hiring process

Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and Design System case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes.

Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations.

Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise.

Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy.

How to apply:

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

listings.title: Senior Product Designer (UX)
listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role:

As a Senior User Experience Designer, you will be responsible for executing high-quality designs for our financial products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior designers, and champion user-centred design within the organisation. This role requires a strategic mindset, deep UX/UI expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into seamless user experiences.

What you’ll do

Define and execute design strategies that align with business objectives and user needs.

Lead the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and final UI execution.

Conduct advanced user research, usability testing, and A/B experiments to validate and refine design solutions.

Partner closely with product managers and engineers to ensure seamless implementation of designs.

Design scalable UI components and contribute to our evolving design system.

Advocate for accessibility (A11y) and inclusive design principles, ensuring our products serve a diverse user base.

Create and refine micro-interactions and motion elements to improve user engagement and usability.

Use data-driven insights to continuously improve the user experience and optimise for business impact.

Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Stay ahead of fintech trends and best practices to drive product innovation.

What you need to succeed

5+ years in a senior product design role, with a strong focus on UX and a demonstrated ability to lead impactful projects

Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory.

Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows.

Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences.

Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making.

Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations.

Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions.

Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.).

Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks.

Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences.

Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers.

Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams.

Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams.

Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries.

Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours.

What you’ll get

A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.

Career growth opportunities.

A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.

Competitive compensation and benefits.

Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

What to expect in the hiring process

Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership.

Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.

Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough.

Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking.

Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

How to apply:

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

You will join a smart, collaborative and passionate team of Recruiters. We take pride in the art of hiring and retaining talent across different functions. As a recruiter, you will partner directly with hiring managers and own end-to-end recruitment. The ideal candidate for this role should have a good understanding of different business functions, good communication skills, good interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and good organizational skills. 

If you thrive in a collaborative team setting, enjoy ownership of your work, and take pride in providing exceptional candidate experience, this might be the role for you, and we would like to hear from you!

What you’ll get to do

Managing end-to-end recruitment process: from job intake, sourcing, scheduling to interviewing, offer negotiation, hiring and onboarding.

Engaging in proactive recruitment strategies to generate pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future needs.

Working closely with hiring managers at all levels to identify current and upcoming staffing needs and build long-lasting working relationships.

Assist in implementing various HR initiatives, including providing recommendations on process and program improvements

Facilitate day to day employee relations, including complaint resolution

Coordinate, administer and facilitate the performance management and talent management for employees

Support the execution of HR strategies, policies, procedures, and programs to sustain continued growth and retention

Minimum 5 years relevant work experience including experience in full life-cycle recruitment, working closely with hiring managers and candidates.

Experience as both an agency recruiter and as an In-house recruiter

Out-of-the-box thinking when it comes to sourcing, candidate management and candidate experience.

Experience hiring for both Technical and Non-Technical roles (Engineering, Business and Commercial positions)

Highly self-motivated and directed; ability to execute tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Experience working with Human Resources Information Systems and Applicant Tracking Systems.

Strong relationship-building skills with stakeholders, team members and candidates.

Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.

Exceptional organization skills and a keen attention to detail.

High business acumen with the ability to align departmental projects & key business objectives.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

A preliminary phone call with the recruiter

A technical interview with the talent acquisition team

A take-home assignment

A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team. 

How to apply: please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile via our career website.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

listings.title: Analytics Manager
listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

At Moniepoint, as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth.

What you’ll do

Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy

Team Building & Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals

Data Insights & Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement?

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life.

Business: Growth

Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products.

Define the product's growth plan and lead execution across the entire funnel from acquisition through to monetisation and retention

Own and optimise specific business metrics or commercial goals, covering the entire funnel from new user acquisition through conversion, activation, retention, and expansion 

Perform detailed product analysis covering the product management funnel with all its aspects, implementing changes into the buying funnel to improve conversion

Design and execute A/B testing programs to optimise sales and conversion rates/adoption at each funnel stage

Lead testing and optimisation efforts for the conversion funnel across offline and online channels, prioritising tests that drive the biggest business impact

Improve the product's design and deploy experiments to improve lifetime value (LTV) and decrease churn 

Technical: Data & Analytics

Use deep, flexible, and comprehensive analytics covering the entire funnel from marketing acquisition to product usage

Analyse user behaviour to improve the sales funnel and increase conversions, using advanced analytics to assess campaign performance and refine strategies

Define and track growth metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), activation rate, retention rate, payback time, and revenue per customer

Conduct cohort analysis and journey mapping to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities

What you need to succeed

+5 years in Analytics and Analytics Management.

2+ years in a management role managing teams and driving strategic initiatives

Proven track record in a consumer-FMCG environment, preferably in a CPG or fintech environment

Deep experience scaling product businesses, with demonstrated ownership of significant revenue targets

Technical Skills

Strong analytical skills with ability to drive metrics and benchmarks, plus experience with growth experiments, A/B testing, and funnel optimisation

Deep SQL knowledge.

Proficiency in product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Grafana, Tableau, Looker, etc)

Deep understanding of data analytics, user behaviour analysis and segmentation

Leadership & Soft Skills

Strong communication skills to interact with teams, stakeholders, and users through verbal presentations, written reports, and visual media 

Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing product teams

Expertise in data analytics tools and digital marketing platforms with the ability to manage and mentor teams of marketers, analysts, and designers

Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and business acumen

Key Performance Indicators

User acquisition and activation rates

Customer retention and churn rates

Expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell)

Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) / Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) ratio

Product adoption metrics

What sets you apart

Advanced degree in Business or STEM

Experience in Growth Analytics, Product analytics, Credit risk analytics

Background in both mass-marketing and product-led growth models

Experience managing P&L or budget responsibility

What you’ll get

Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

Online SQL take-home task (30 mins): Take-home test.

Business Case 1 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.

Business Case 2 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.

Exec Interview (30 mins - 1 hour): Culture Fit. No take-home required.

Deep SQL knowledge.

listings.description:

Department / Function: Commercial & Field Operations

Reports To: State Coordinator

Location: Field-based, Nigeria

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance-based commission

About Moniepoint

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions and process over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job purpose

Drives business growth by expanding our merchant footprint, building high-value customer relationships, and introducing financial solutions tailored to local business needs. This role is responsible for end-to-end merchant acquisition, terminal deployment, and account retention across assigned commercial areas.

Key responsibilities

→ Identify, visit, and onboard prospective merchants through field engagement, referrals, and local trade community outreach.

→ Educate business owners on Moniepoint’s suite of products, recommending solutions that match their operational and growth goals.

→ Achieve and exceed monthly targets for active merchant onboarding, terminal deployment, loan disbursements, and repayments.

→ Oversee end-to-end merchant onboarding, ensuring accurate KYC documentation and strict adherence to operational SOPs and regulatory guidelines.

→ Build and nurture long-term relationships with merchants to encourage account activity, high transaction volume, and ongoing retention.

→ Conduct transparent discussions on pricing, terms, and agreements within established company guidelines to build trusted partnerships.

→ Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries, resolving issues promptly or escalating complex operational needs appropriately.

→ Gather local market intelligence and competitor activity, providing actionable feedback to field leadership to help refine growth tactics.

→ Maintain accurate pipeline records and submit timely field performance reports using CRM tools.

Qualifications

→ Bachelor’s degree, Higher National Diploma (HND), or Ordinary National Diploma (OND) from a recognised tertiary institution.

→ 2 to 4 years of hands-on sales experience, preferably within banking, fintech, payment services, or fast-moving commercial environments.

→ Proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets in merchant onboarding, field sales, or client acquisition.

→ Deep understanding of the local financial services landscape and regional trading dynamics.

→ Strong communication and customer relationship skills.

Preferred qualifications

→ Practical experience with POS terminal deployment, payment acquiring, or business loan products.

→ Proficiency in CRM software for field tracking, pipeline management, and activity reporting.

What we can offer you

Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

A preliminary phone call with the recruiter

An interview with the Hiring Team.

An interview with a member of our Executive team.

Job Title: Data Entry Officer

Reports To: Lead, Onboarding

Work Mode: Outsourced and Hybrid

Job Purpose

The Data Entry Specialist ensures that customer accounts, product catalogues, inventory records, and pricing data are accurately entered and maintained within the Moniebook platform. Working closely with Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers, you keep data clean and ready from day one, enabling fast go-lives, reliable reporting, and a smooth experience for every retail customer. Success is measured by accuracy rates, turnaround time, and your contribution to a scalable, error-free operational foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Data Entry & Record Management

Input, update, and maintain merchant data, including product catalogues, SKUs, pricing, inventory levels, and customer profiles.

Process bulk data imports from spreadsheets and CSV files, validating format and completeness before upload.

Ensure all records adhere to Moniebook's data standards and naming conventions.

Onboarding Data Support

Prepare merchant accounts ahead of onboarding by populating required product, inventory, and configuration data within agreed timelines.

Review merchant-submitted data templates for errors or missing fields and follow up to resolve gaps before entry.

Support the setup of catalogue structures, tax configurations, and payment settings as directed by the Onboarding team.

Data Validation & Quality Assurance

Conduct checks to identify and correct errors, duplicates, or outdated records.

Cross-reference data across spreadsheets, CRM, and POS backend to ensure consistency.

Flag and document data anomalies, routing them to the appropriate team for resolution.

Process & Documentation

Maintain accurate records of data entry activities, import logs, and correction history in the CRM.

Document common errors and resolutions to build a shared knowledge base and reduce repeat mistakes.

Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and recommend improvements to the Operations lead.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Fulfil ad-hoc data requests from Onboarding Specialists, Account Managers, and Support teams within SLA windows.

Coordinate with internal teams to gather missing customer data without delaying onboarding timelines.

Qualifications

1-3 years in data entry, data operations, or a similar role — preferably in SaaS, retail tech, or fintech.

Exceptional attention to detail with a track record of high accuracy across large data volumes.

Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (data cleaning, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas).

Familiarity with CRM platforms or POS/back-office SaaS tools.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred

Experience with bulk CSV imports, data migration, or catalogue management in a SaaS context.

Exposure to retail operations, inventory systems, or point-of-sale platforms.

Experience supporting an onboarding, implementation, or customer success team.

The candidate should be based in Edo State - Oredo

About You

You're obsessively detail-oriented and take genuine pride in clean, accurate data.

You're process-driven but proactive, you follow workflows and flag problems before they escalate.

You're a team player who understands that your work sits at the heart of the customer journey.

You're calm under pressure and can handle high volumes without cutting corners.

You're tech-savvy and always looking for smarter, faster ways to work.

What Success Looks Like

99%+ data entry accuracy across merchant account builds and catalogue uploads.

Zero go-live delays attributable to data readiness.

All ad-hoc data requests fulfilled within defined SLA windows

Open task backlog kept below 5% at any given time.

Achieve >4.5+ average rating score from Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers on data quality and turnaround.

listings.title: Data Governance Policy & Controls Specialist
listings.description:
Who we are 

Moniepoint is an all-in-one digital financial services platform powering businesses across emerging markets. Since 2019, our technology has enabled over one million businesses to thrive through comprehensive payment, banking, credit, and business management solutions. Operating through its subsidiaries—including Moniepoint MFB and TeamApt Ltd—Moniepoint processes the majority of Nigeria's POS transactions, representing over $170 billion in annualised Total Payment Volume (TPV). Recognised as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech platform and named the Most Inclusive Payment Platform by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) in 2022, Moniepoint continues to scale its profitable financial ecosystem.

About this role

The Senior Data Governance, Policy & Control Specialist is responsible for driving enterprise-wide data governance initiatives, policy management, audit coordination, and control enforcement across the Bank. The role ensures that data management practices align with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and the Bank's risk appetite.

What you will get to do

Policy & Framework Management: Lead the drafting, review, implementation, and periodic renewal of data governance policies, standards, frameworks, and procedures. Design and maintain the overarching data governance framework and own the full policy lifecycle. Ensure policies align with regulatory requirements, translate them into actionable governance policy language, and conduct policy gap analysis to recommend improvements.

Governance & Implementation Oversight: Oversee the enterprise-wide implementation of data governance initiatives and monitor compliance with established data governance standards, controls, and regulatory requirements.

Audit & Compliance Coordination: Coordinate and manage internal and external audits relating to the Enterprise Data Office.

Data Stewardship Program: Implement the enterprise data stewardship program, defining and operationalising data ownership across domains.

Controls & Compliance Monitoring: Design and implement data governance controls to monitor policy compliance across business units. Conduct periodic control testing, self-assessments, and gap analyses. Maintain the data governance risk and issue register, ensuring timely escalation and remediation of control failures, and support audits by providing evidence of governance controls.

Data Culture & Enablement: Design and deliver data governance training, awareness campaigns, and onboarding materials to build data literacy. Embed governance practices into everyday business and technical workflows, act as a trusted advisor to business units, and champion data governance value internally.

Experience & Background

Bachelor's degree in Business, Law, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.

5+ years of experience in data governance, risk, compliance, or policy/controls roles.

Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, insurance, telecom, etc.).

Prior experience running change management, training programs, or culture-building initiatives.

Working knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g., DCAM, DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT) and relevant regulations (GDPR, NDPA).

Deep familiarity with modern data architectures (Medallion, Data Mesh, Data Vault 2.0) and implementing governance within distributed environments.

Skills & Competencies

Demonstrated experience drafting and maintaining policies, standards, and control frameworks.

Experience designing or executing controls testing, risk assessments, or compliance monitoring.

Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, enforceable policy documentation.

Excellent stakeholder management and training/facilitation skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

Professional certification such as DCAM, CDMP, DGSP, CIPP, or equivalent.

Experience with GRC (governance, risk & compliance) tooling or policy management platforms.

Familiarity with data quality, metadata, and lineage disciplines and how they connect to policy and controls.

What success looks like in this role

Data management practices are fully aligned with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and the Bank's risk appetite.

Data governance policies, standards, and controls are consistently adopted and seamlessly embedded into everyday business and technical workflows.

The data governance risk and issue register is maintained proactively, with internal and external audits coordinated smoothly and control failures remediated promptly.

listings.title: Data Privacy & Protection Director
listings.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Data Privacy & Protection Director

Department: Compliance

Reports to: Chief Compliance Officer

Location: Lagos, Nigeria

About this role

The Data Privacy & Protection Director provides expertise and support in data privacy and protection matters, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements such as the Nigerian Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023 and other relevant data protection laws. The role oversees the entire data protection strategy, driving the implementation of policies and procedures that safeguard personal data and maintain the organization’s reputation for data security. You will also be responsible for managing the organization’s compliance framework, including conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and overseeing data breach response efforts.

Responsibilities

Governance Framework: Implement a data privacy governance framework (including Binding Corporate Rules) to manage data use in compliance with the Nigeria Data Privacy Act (NDPA) 2023. 

Policy Development: Set standards, formulate policies, and establish procedures for the organization to meet NDPA 2023 and other relevant regulations and requirements. 

Stakeholder Awareness: Ensure that employees, third-party processors (TPPs), vendors, and data subjects are fully informed about their data protection rights, obligations, and responsibilities. 

Regulatory Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison for the Nigeria Data Privacy Commission (NDPC), other regulators, financial institutions, and customers on data privacy and protection-related matters. 

Query & Incident Resolution: Handle queries, complaints, claims, and notifications from regulators, law enforcement agencies, and data subjects, ensuring prompt feedback and resolutions. 

Impact Assessments: Work with product managers, project managers, and other internal stakeholders to conduct data privacy impact assessments (DPIAs) to ensure compliance with NDPA 2023 and extant regulations. 

Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with IT teams to ensure that IT systems and procedures comply with NDPA and other relevant regulations. 

Security Coordination: Collaborate with the information security team to maintain records of customer data and data processing activities, while sustaining a data security management plan, a data breach response plan, and data retention structures. 

Training Strategy: Develop strategies to ensure continuous engagement with key internal and external stakeholders, and deliver targeted data privacy training to various business functions, TPPs, and vendors. 

Privacy Audits: Coordinate and conduct routine privacy audits, including a comprehensive review of the active privacy governance framework. 

External Auditing: Work closely with the Data Privacy Compliance Organization (DPCO) to conduct external regulatory audits and provide guidance and advice on privacy-related regulatory issues. 

Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor updates to local data privacy laws and regulations and make proactive recommendations to executive leadership when appropriate. 

Experience & Background

Educational Background: A Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree in information security or law is highly preferred. 

Required Experience: Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in data protection, compliance, or a related field, with a deep operational understanding of the NDPA and other relevant data protection laws. 

Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing data privacy in complex organizational settings, including executing data protection audits, leading DPIAs, and managing data breach responses. 

Professional Certifications: Relevant certifications in data protection/privacy (such as CISSP, CIPM, CIPP, CPT, CDPSE, or CDPO) are highly preferred. 

Skills & Competencies

Regulatory Insight: Mastery of data privacy legislations, framework applications, and financial sector compliance structures. 

Analytical Skills: Strong capability to break down complex system flows, audit technical processing records, and discover potential vulnerabilities in data privacy management. 

Ethical Integrity: Uncompromising commitment to confidentiality, objectiveness, and ethical compliance standards. 

Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to successfully collaborate with regulators, external bodies, and internal cross-functional stakeholders. 

Leadership: Strong capability to direct compliance sub-functions, spearhead company-wide training initiatives, and influence technical or product decisions. 

What success looks like in this role

Perfect Regulatory Standing: Total alignment with the NDPC, resulting in smooth external regulatory audits and zero compliance violations or penalties. 

Flawless Risk Mitigation: Active, seamless execution of DPIAs for all internal structures, products, and tool variations prior to deployment. 

Proactive Incident Management: Rapid and completely documented closure of queries, compliance gaps, and unexpected breach notification vulnerabilities within strict timelines. 

High Organizational Maturity: An established and well-maintained culture of data safety where employees and third-party partners clearly follow data processing protocols. 

Why join us

Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. 

A collaborative and supportive work culture dedicated to professional development and continuous learning.

Operating through its subsidiaries—including Moniepoint MFB and TeamApt Ltd—Moniepoint processes the majority of Nigeria's POS transactions, representing over $170 billion in annualised Total Payment Volume (TPV). Recognised as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech platform and named the Most Inclusive Payment Platform by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) in 2022, Moniepoint continues to scale its profitable financial ecosystem.

About this role

At Moniepoint, data serves as the foundation of our financial operating system. The Senior Data Quality Analyst will define, measure, monitor, and elevate the quality of enterprise data assets. Reporting directly to the Head of Data Governance, this role collaborates with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Data Engineering, and cross-functional business units to ensure data remains accurate, complete, consistent, timely, and fit for purpose. Beyond managing technical frameworks, this position acts as a cultural catalyst for data accountability—guiding a cross-functional network of Data Stewards across domains such as Finance and Sales to establish unified, enterprise-grade data management standards that protect and optimise data for over 13 million customers.

Responsibilities

Framework & Metrics Execution: Implement and maintain data quality rules, metrics, and thresholds across priority data domains.

Profiling & Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct comprehensive data profiling and quality assessments to identify anomalies, structural gaps, and underlying causes of degraded data quality.

Reporting & Governance Dashboards: Develop and maintain data quality scorecards and operational dashboards to report trends, risks, and health metrics to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Standards & Remediation Collaboration: Partner with Data Owners and Stewards to define acceptance criteria for critical data elements (CDEs) and lead remediation initiatives for high-impact or recurring data issues.

Tooling & Architecture Integration: Configure and support enterprise data quality platforms (e.g., catalog integrations, automated monitoring) and collaborate with Data Engineering to embed quality checks directly into ETL/ELT pipelines.

Documentation & Compliance: Maintain data quality playbooks, rule libraries, and issue logs. Support internal/external audits and regulatory compliance reviews by presenting evidence of robust data quality controls.

Governance Advancement: Drive broader enterprise data governance initiatives, including metadata management, data lineage, data classification, and policy enforcement.

Experience & Background

Bachelor’s degree in Data Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

5+ years of experience in data quality, data governance, or advanced data analytics.

Prior experience within regulated sectors, specifically Financial Services, Fintech, Telecommunications, or Insurance.

Strong working knowledge of data privacy regulations, including NDPR, GDPR, and fintech compliance standards.

Solid foundation in core data governance principles, including data ownership, stewardship models, lineage, and data classification.

Deep familiarity with modern data architectures (Medallion, Data Mesh, Data Vault 2.0) and implementing governance within distributed environments.

Experience mentoring junior analysts or leading discrete governance workstreams.

Skills & Competencies

Advanced SQL skills with extensive experience querying, profiling, and analysing complex, large-scale datasets.

High proficiency in Python/SQL for automating data quality checks, accessing APIs, and querying data platforms directly.

Practical experience with enterprise data governance and profiling platforms (e.g., Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Solidatus, Informatica DQ, DataHub).

Proven track record building data quality dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Apache Superset, Grafana, Metabase, or TIBCO.

Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable business insights.

What success looks like in this role

Data quality frameworks, metrics, and thresholds are successfully implemented and maintained across all priority data domains.

Data quality scorecards and operational dashboards provide executive leadership and key stakeholders with clear, actionable insights into data health and risks.

A strong culture of data accountability is established across cross-functional domains, empowering Data Stewards to uphold unified management standards.

High-impact data issues are effectively remediated, and robust quality controls are seamlessly embedded into ETL/ELT pipelines.

What we can offer you

Culture -We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

A preliminary phone call with the recruiter

A technical interview with the Hiring Manager 

A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team. 

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

listings.title: Early Careers Talent Acquisition Specialist
listings.description:
About Moniepoint and Your Team

At Moniepoint, we are on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, everywhere. From pioneering digital payments to powering millions of businesses across the continent, we build innovative, dependable products that everyday people rely on.

As part of the People Team, Talent Acquisition doesn't just fill open roles; we shape how great talent discovers, joins, and thrives at Moniepoint. You'll join a collaborative, ambitious team of recruiters, sourcers, and operations specialists who care deeply about candidate experience, equity, and operational excellence.

Job Purpose

The Early Careers TA Specialist leads the operational delivery of Moniepoint's structured early-talent ecosystem, spanning university partnerships, campus hackathons, structured internships, and graduate conversions.

In this role, you'll partner closely with the Senior TA Strategy & Enablement Manager to turn strategic vision into high-impact, repeatable programmes. You'll own the day-to-day rhythm of our campus presence and early-career cohorts, ensuring every student, graduate, and intern experiences a transparent, supportive, and inspiring journey into Moniepoint.

Key Responsibilities

1. Campus Engagement & Community Presence

Build and execute a clear, engaging playbook for how Moniepoint connects with university students and emerging talent through hackathons, tech talks, campus career fairs, and community hubs.

Run the annual early-careers recruiting calendar, aligning outreach windows, assessment cycles, and start dates into a predictable, well-communicated rhythm.

Establish and nurture long-term partnerships with universities, student societies, and tech communities across Nigeria to build balanced, diverse talent pipelines year after year.

2. Internship & Graduate Programme Delivery

Deliver a structured, end-to-end internship experience—including recruiting, pre-boarding, cohort programming, manager enablement, and conversion into full-time roles.

Partner with hiring managers and team leads to define project scopes, secure dedicated mentors, and ensure interns work on meaningful, real-world problems.

Manage transparent, objective conversion assessments at each stage of the cohort lifecycle using structured, skill-based criteria.

3. Recruiting Infrastructure & Candidate Experience

Design and manage smooth application, screening, and interview workflows for high-volume cohorts within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Collaborate with assessment partners and vendors to deliver fair, accessible, and bias-free evaluation stages for all candidates.

Coordinate with People Operations, IT, and workplace teams to ensure seamless onboarding and Day 1 readiness for every cohort.

Provide mentorship and day-to-day guidance to junior recruiters or coordinators supporting early-talent pipelines as the function expands.

4. Insights, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Track key programme metrics, including application conversion rates, cohort diversity, candidate Net Promoter Score (NPS), and post-internship retention.

Gather feedback from candidates, interns, and hiring managers to simplify processes and continuously improve programme quality.

Share regular progress updates and data-driven recommendations with the wider TA leadership.

Qualifications

5-7 years of talent acquisition experience, with proven exposure to campus recruiting, university relations, early-career programmes, or cohort hiring.

Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects or multi-stakeholder programmes with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Practical experience using modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate evaluation tools.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to connect authentically with university students and senior stakeholders alike.

Solid understanding of the Nigerian higher education landscape and emerging talent communities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing or running student hackathons, innovation challenges, or specialized STEM recruitment initiatives.

Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, or fast-paced corporate environments.

Familiarity with funnel analytics, spreadsheet reporting, or presentation design for leadership reviews.

About You

You're an empathetic communicator: You listen well, build genuine trust with students and hiring managers, and make every candidate feel valued and respected.

You bring structure to complex projects: You enjoy taking multiple moving parts—dates, venues, mentors, candidate lists—and organizing them into clear, dependable workflows.

You're a collaborative problem-solver: You approach challenges with curiosity, ask thoughtful questions, and work constructively with hiring managers to find solutions that benefit everyone.

You care deeply about fairness: You believe great talent comes from diverse backgrounds, and you actively champion objective, inclusive hiring practices.

You're human and grounded: You communicate with clarity, keep things simple, and bring positive energy and humility to your team every day.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

listings.title: Engineering Manager
listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Portugal

We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.
So, now we are looking for our Engineering Managers to join us in Portugal.

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy.

What you’ll get to do

Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.

Evaluate business and product requirements for technical feasibility and architectural alignment, translating them into well-defined EPICs and technical user stories.

Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineers to continuously refine, groom, and prioritize the backlog.

Plan and drive sprint execution with clearly defined goals, using project planning tools to establish timelines, delivery milestones, and surface dependencies early.

Champion engineering processes and rituals that enable strong collaboration, accountability, and team efficiency.

Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments.

Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution.

Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality.

Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs.

Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement.

To succeed in this role, you should have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role.

5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot.

Minimum 3 years of proven engineering leadership experience managing high-performing teams.

Solid grasp of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.

Demonstrated ability to translate complex product requirements into well-structured EPICs, user stories, and tasks.

Strong backend engineering expertise; exposure to frontend technologies is a plus.

Experience with project planning and tracking tools to visualize and manage delivery timelines.

Familiarity with engineering, product health metrics, and monitoring tools to drive data-informed decisions.

Hands-on capability to debug complex production issues, lead incident response, and conduct blameless RCA.

Good understanding of modern deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and associated metrics.

Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.

Excellent risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication skills.

Proven track record of improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and engineering excellence.

Generic Skills

Problem-solving: Ability to assess complex problems, find solutions, and make sound decisions.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting.

Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment, adjusting strategies as needed.

Attention to Detail: Meticulous in documenting technical requirements and ensuring all aspects of a project are accounted for.

Supervisory skills

Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring engineers, ensuring team growth and performance.

Resource Allocation: Ability to assess bandwidth and manage resource distribution to optimize team performance.

Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment.

Stakeholder Management: Lead project status reviews, manage expectations, and ensure smooth communication between teams and leadership.

What we can offer you

Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.

A live coding and code review session.

A system design and technical discussion round. 

A project planning, execution, and product thinking round.

A behavioral and technical interview with the hiring manager.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

listings.title: Engineering Relations Partner
listings.description:
About Moniepoint

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R&D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

This is a technical content execution role requiring strong, foundational engineering skills. You will translate what our engineers build and learn into high-quality narratives: the kind that earns genuine respect in engineering communities, gets accepted at top-tier conferences, and attracts exceptional engineers from around the world.

The right person for this role is a skilled engineer who has found their voice as a writer and communicator; someone who can walk into a room of engineers as a peer, ask the right questions, and come out with a story worth telling.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you must have:

Strong engineering capabilities: A solid background in computer science or software engineering. You have written and shipped code professionally, understand modern system architectures, and can deeply engage with complex technical concepts.

Technical depth: Experience working within fintech, infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-scale engineering environments where you can comfortably read codebases, interpret technical documentation, and grasp deep architecture choices.

Exceptional writing skills: Clarity, precision, and the ability to articulate intricate technical trade-offs and ideas accessibly without oversimplifying or watering them down.

Proactive narrative instinct: The ability to independently dive into engineering projects, spot the most compelling technical breakthroughs or lessons, and build content around them without needing explicit instruction.

Technical credibility: A genuine, firsthand understanding of what makes technical content credible, shareable, and respected by discerning engineering communities.

Autonomy: The ability to manage multiple projects, technical interviews, and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.

It's a strong plus if you have:

Active engineering or open-source involvement: An active presence in developer spaces, an updated technical blog, open-source contributions, or a history of speaking at engineering conferences.

Developer Relations experience: Background in DevRel or managing technical communities, showing you know how to engage developers authentically at scale.

Track record in technical publishing: Experience drafting accepted conference abstracts/proposals (CFPs) for recognized industry events.

Multimodal content production: Experience writing technical video scripts, technical teardowns, or working alongside creative production teams.

What to expect in the hiring process

A preliminary phone call with the recruiter

A take-home assessment

Panel interview

Executive interview

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R&D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

This is a technical content execution role requiring strong, foundational engineering skills. You will translate what our engineers build and learn into high-quality narratives: the kind that earns genuine respect in engineering communities, gets accepted at top-tier conferences, and attracts exceptional engineers from around the world.

The right person for this role is a skilled engineer who has found their voice as a writer and communicator; someone who can walk into a room of engineers as a peer, ask the right questions, and come out with a story worth telling.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you must have:

Strong engineering capabilities: A solid background in computer science or software engineering. You have written and shipped code professionally, understand modern system architectures, and can deeply engage with complex technical concepts.

Technical depth: Experience working within fintech, infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-scale engineering environments where you can comfortably read codebases, interpret technical documentation, and grasp deep architecture choices.

Exceptional writing skills: Clarity, precision, and the ability to articulate intricate technical trade-offs and ideas accessibly without oversimplifying or watering them down.

Proactive narrative instinct: The ability to independently dive into engineering projects, spot the most compelling technical breakthroughs or lessons, and build content around them without needing explicit instruction.

Technical credibility: A genuine, firsthand understanding of what makes technical content credible, shareable, and respected by discerning engineering communities.

Autonomy: The ability to manage multiple projects, technical interviews, and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.

It's a strong plus if you have:

Active engineering or open-source involvement: An active presence in developer spaces, an updated technical blog, open-source contributions, or a history of speaking at engineering conferences.

Developer Relations experience: Background in DevRel or managing technical communities, showing you know how to engage developers authentically at scale.

Track record in technical publishing: Experience drafting accepted conference abstracts/proposals (CFPs) for recognized industry events.

Multimodal content production: Experience writing technical video scripts, technical teardowns, or working alongside creative production teams.

What to expect in the hiring process

A preliminary phone call with the recruiter

A take-home assessment

Panel interview

Executive interview

listings.title: Field Credit Officer (Anambra)
listings.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:

Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint 

Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit 

Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available 

Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration 

Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing 

Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance 

Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience & Background:

Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline 

Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution 

Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis 

Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage 

Must be resident in Anambra

Skills & Competencies:

Apt attention to details 

Proven simple/complex analytical skills 

Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills 

Agility and perseverance 

What success looks like in this role:

Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets. 

Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring. 

Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts. 

Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital. 

Why join us: 

Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. 

Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.

listings.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About Moniebook

The all-in-one business management software for retail and restaurant businesses. We sell, track inventory, manage bookkeeping, and accept payments — all from one platform. Offline-first, mobile-ready, and built for how Nigerian businesses actually operate. For more info https://moniepoint.com/moniebook

Job Title: Field Sales Lead

Reports to: Head, Customer Acquisition

Location: Nigeria (Field)

About this role

The Field Sales Lead drives acquisition and conversion performance across assigned regions by recruiting, managing, coaching, and supporting a team of Field Sales Agents (FSAs). You will serve as the operational hub of the regional field sales function, owning agent recruitment pipelines, ensuring consistent field activity, and delivering against regional acquisition targets. This is a hands-on, frontline role that combines team building with active performance management and structured field support.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Coaching

Lead & Develop: Manage a team of Field Sales Agents across assigned states, providing daily direction, motivation, and performance support.

Coach: Conduct regular meetings, field ride-alongs, and coaching sessions to develop FSAs' product knowledge, objection handling, and acquisition skills.

Onboard: Onboard new Field Sales Agents and ensure they are fully ramped and hitting activity targets within their first 30 days.

Performance Management: Identify frontline skill gaps and run targeted coaching interventions to address them quickly.

FSA Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

Recruit: Own the end-to-end recruitment pipeline for Field Sales Agents in your region, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and recommending candidates for hire.

Pipeline Building: Maintain a live talent bench by proactively building relationships with potential FSA candidates in your states, ensuring the region is never understaffed.

Workforce Planning: Partner with the Operations team to forecast FSA headcount needs based on regional acquisition targets and attrition trends.

Recruitment Reporting: Track time-to-fill and onboarding completion rates, flagging recruitment blockers to leadership in a timely manner.

Sales Operations & Performance

Drive Targets: Own region-level acquisition targets (weekly and monthly) and ensure individual FSAs meet their assigned quotas.

Track Activity: Monitor daily field activity metrics, visits completed, leads generated, acquisitions recorded, and follow-ups made, and intervene when performance trends downward.

Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed.

Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis.

Process & Quality Assurance

Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines.

Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions.

Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams.

Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers.

Experience & Background

4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity.

Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role.

Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas.

Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast.

Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like.

Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth.

Data-Informed & People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage.

Agility & Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly.

Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities.

Communication & Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows.

What success looks like in this role

Weeks 1–2: Complete full product and playbook onboarding. Shadow all FSAs in the field. Establish cadences with team members. Audit the existing FSA recruitment pipeline and playbook.

Weeks 3–4: Run first structured field review sessions. Identify any headcount gaps and initiate active FSA recruitment in understaffed states.

Month 2: Fully own regional KPI tracking on a weekly basis. Fill open FSA roles and ensure all new hires are progressing through onboarding on schedule.

Month 3: Region achieves 85%–100% of the monthly acquisition quota. FSAs have active coaching plans in place, and the recruitment pipeline remains healthy.

Why join us

Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities.

Dynamic field support structures and tools built to facilitate high-performance execution.

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech brand driving financial inclusion.

Track Activity: Monitor daily field activity metrics, visits completed, leads generated, acquisitions recorded, and follow-ups made, and intervene when performance trends downward.

Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed.

Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis.

Process & Quality Assurance

Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines.

Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions.

Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams.

Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers.

Experience & Background

4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity.

Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role.

Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas.

Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast.

Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like.

Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth.

Data-Informed & People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage.

Agility & Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly.

Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities.

Communication & Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows.

Why join us

Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities.

Dynamic field support structures and tools built to facilitate high-performance execution.

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech brand driving financial inclusion.
