listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is one of Africa’s fastest-growing fintech companies, recognised by the Financial Times for three consecutive years. We provide an end-to-end financial ecosystem powering payments, banking, credit, and business tools for over 10 million users, processing more than $250B+ in annual transaction value.

In 2024-2025, Moniepoint completed a Series C fundraise exceeding $200 million, backed by leading global investors including Visa, Google’s Africa Investment Fund, Development Partners International, LeapFrog Investments, Lightrock, and IFC. This investment underscores our scale, profitability, and long-term roadmap and solidifies Moniepoint’s position as one of Africa’s fintech unicorns.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About the role

We are hiring a Technical Recruiter with demonstrated ownership of the full hiring lifecycle and the ability to operate with clarity, structure, and consistency. This role requires a professional who is comfortable managing complex hiring pipelines, partnering with senior leaders, and recruiting for niche and high-impact roles across engineering and supporting functions. The ideal candidate brings discipline, accountability, and an informed understanding of talent markets, particularly within technology.

What you’ll get to do

Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including requirement intake, sourcing, assessment, stakeholder alignment, offer management, and onboarding.

Develop and execute structured sourcing strategies to engage strong talent across active and passive markets.

Build trusted advisory relationships with hiring managers and business leaders to understand role requirements, workforce plans, and organizational priorities.

Maintain and continuously develop a pipeline of technical and leadership candidates for current and future hiring needs.

Collaborate with HR and business teams to streamline hiring processes, support workforce planning, and contribute to long-term talent strategy.

Utilize recruitment systems, reporting, and data to drive transparency, measure progress, and support process improvements.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have:

Minimum 5 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, preferably with exposure to high-growth or technology-led environments.

Demonstrated capability in sourcing and engaging passive candidates using structured research methods and diverse talent channels.

Proven experience hiring senior-level engineering talent and technical leadership roles.

Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to set clear expectations, provide structured updates, and drive alignment through delivery.

Experience hiring across multiple functional areas, including Engineering, Product, Business, and Commercial roles.

High degree of ownership, self-management, and follow-through.

Familiarity with ATS platforms and HR systems, and ability to apply data to refine hiring decisions and workflows.

Clear, structured approach to communication and documentation.

Strong commercial understanding of how effective hiring supports organizational priorities and workforce growth.

What we can offer you

Work environment: A culture grounded in respect, accountability, and support. We value clarity, fairness, and consistent delivery.

Development: Opportunities for professional growth through structured learning, knowledge-sharing, and access to subject-matter expertise.

Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based annual bonus, pension, health insurance, and additional benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

A technical interview with the talent acquisition team

A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the TA leadership team. 

How to Apply

Please submit your CV or LinkedIn profile through our careers platform. All applications will be reviewed, and candidates whose profiles meet the requirements will be contacted.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

listings.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Team Lead, SRE to guide a squad of site reliability engineers responsible for the reliability of our highly distributed financial platform. You will be designing high-level reliability architecture, while also mentoring engineers, defining the technical roadmap, and driving the culture of Site Reliability Engineering within a team. You will balance strategic leadership with deep technical work to ensure our systems and our people can scale linearly with our hyper-growth.

Responsibilities

Set the technical direction for the SRE team. Architect self-healing systems, define reliability standards (Production Readiness Reviews), and drive the adoption of observability as Code and automation best practices.

Define and enforce the end-to-end standard for system visibility. You will guide teams to deeply instrument their code (logging, tracing, metrics) and govern the monitoring ecosystem to ensure alerts are actionable, strictly minimizing noise (alert fatigue) while maximizing our ability to detect and resolve issues proactively.

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Senior and Associate SREs. Conduct code reviews, facilitate technical workshops and foster a culture of engineering excellence.

Act as the ultimate escalation point for major incidents. Beyond firefighting, you will refine the Incident management process, ensuring the process is efficient and that RCAs lead to actionable engineering fixes.

 Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Leads to define Service Level Objectives (SLOs) that align with business goals. 

Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of experience in SRE or Backend Engineering, with at least 2 years in a Lead or Senior/Staff role mentoring others.

Expert-level proficiency in Java, Go, Rust, or Python. You set the standard for code quality within the team.

Mastery of distributed systems patterns. You can design scalable architectures, debug complex microservices interactions, and explain architectural trade-offs to stakeholders.

Deep expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS.  You have extensive experience running Kubernetes (GKE) at scale and troubleshooting deep infrastructure issues.

Proven experience defining observability strategies for large teams. You have deep expertise in architecting the complete telemetry stack: from custom instrumentation to monitoring and actionable alerting.

Strong communication skills with the ability to de-escalate high-pressure war rooms with calm authority.

listings.title: Procurement Senior Coordinator
listings.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions.

To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

The Procurement Senior Coordinator ensures high-quality Solar & Non-Ag Farmer inputs are purchased in a cost-efficient, market-competitive & compliant manner and are delivered on time every time through execution excellence.

Responsibilities

Procurement Excellence

Drive execution excellence by achieving +90% OTIF and market-competitive COGS, securing +5% cost savings while guaranteeing quality control, maintaining >80% timely Open PO closure, and ensuring +80% on-time payments across all OAF countries of operation.

Drive execution excellence by coordinating taxes, duties, clearances, and freight to effectively mitigate operational risks and ensure deliveries are on time, every time.

Execute the procurement strategy for Solar and Non-ag products.

Use proactive risk mitigation, retroactive root cause analysis, and effective communication to implement action plans that address any gaps in service or execution to farmers and teams now and in the future.

We are seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Supervisor with a minimum of 2 years experience who will support the daily compliance and quality assurance processes of the macadamia factory from receipt through processing to dispatch of products ensuring compliance to customer, internal, legal and statutory requirements

Responsibilities

Materials Management (Raw & Processing Aids)

Raw Material Intake: Oversee the Raw Material  receiving checks. Verify the quality of incoming raw nuts (Good quality, SKR, Moisture content)

Packaging Inventory: Manage the quality of packaging materials and other processing aids before acceptance to the processing factory

Product Integrity & Quality Assurance

Finished Product Compliance: Oversee the grading and classification of macadamia kernels  to ensure they meet international  standards and customer specifications regarding size, color, and quality  defect limits.

In Process Quality Control: Manage the hourly sampling regime at key stages (Cracking, Sorting, Drying). Ensure operators are correctly identifying critical defects such as immature nuts, insect damage, and mold.

Sensory Analysis: Enforce organoleptic testing protocols to detect early signs of rancidity (oxidative stability) or off-flavors caused by improper drying or storage.

Hold & Release: Authority to place On Hold any batch of nuts that fails moisture specs or shows signs of contamination, preventing it from reaching the packing line.

Verify monitoring records for defined Critical Control Points (e.g., drying temperatures for Salmonella control, metal detection for physical hazards).

Conduct independent verification checks on CCP records to ensure accuracy and prevent record falsification

Monitor Operational Prerequisite Programs (OPRPs) such as allergen controls (if applicable), sieving, or sorting performance.

Immediately escalate deviations from critical limits and ensure corrective actions are implemented and documented.

Management of Team Performance (Quality of Inspectors)

Monitoring the Monitors,  You are responsible for the accuracy of your team.

QA Inspectors: Support in the incoming material checks, in process line checks, sorting/operators team quality of work against standards and final packing inspectors quality of work 

Sanitation Inspectors: Inspect the cleaners work after they finish but before production starts. Provide immediate feedback if residue is found.

Training & Competency: Maintain training matrices for both teams. Ensure sanitation staff understand Hygiene, sanitation and chemical safety and QA staff understand sampling validity, process checks and customer requirements

Resource Allocation: Manage shift rotas to ensure coverage during peak seasons, ensuring no production line runs without QA presence and no cleanup happens without supervision.

 Final Product Confirmation & Release Support

Review laboratory results, moisture confirmations, grading reports, and packaging compliance before recommending product release

Verify finished products meet internal specifications, export standards, and customer-specific requirements

Ensure finished products are not dispatched without documented quality confirmation

Maintain records of product approvals and quality release confirmations

Prerequisite Programs (PRP) Inspection & Reporting

Conduct routine PRP inspections covering sanitation effectiveness, pest control trends, glass & hard plastic control, environmental monitoring, hygiene compliance, and waste management

Review pest control service reports and escalate adverse trends

Support zoning enforcement between Low Risk and High Care areas to prevent cross-contamination

Document inspection findings and report gaps for corrective action

listings.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions.

To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

We believe that new technology is critical to building the most effective rural distribution network on the African continent. Today, we reach over 5.6 million farmers, and we aspire to serve more than 10 million households in the coming decade. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead the development of our technology, focusing on a mobile tech transformation: providing our field staff with the mobile-based tools to reach more farmers; developing scalable, direct communication channels with farmers to improve customer service; and digitizing and decentralizing data collection tools to speed up data flows and improve efficiency.

We are looking for someone with the technical experience to bring this vision to life; the Director of Engineering will transform our technology into a core organizational strength, working through several development teams that cross our tech stack

Responsibilities

Set and steer engineering strategy & vision: In partnership with the CTO, the Head of Engineering, OCTO (Office of the CTO), Product, AI Enablement, and InfoSec, you will shape and execute our engineering strategy and ensure alignment with the broader Technology Division and One Acre Fund business strategy. Specifically:

Build a high-performing engineering practice that applies industry best practices for continuous delivery, automated testing, observability, and information security by default.

Co-own DORA-led engineering health (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, MTTR) and drive measurable, continuous improvement.

Partner closely with Product to deliver a unified roadmap across the Experience Teams, ensuring engineering capacity is matched to the highest-value outcomes.

Partner with the AI Enablement Team (AI Architect and Senior AI Engineers) to embed AI capability into core platforms.

Co-own completion of the Azure → AWS cloud migration alongside the DevOps lead, and steer the engineering organisation into an AWS-native operating model.

Develop leaders and build the team: You will lead a team of approximately 50 engineers, including direct management of 5+ engineering managers/team leads. You are responsible for professional growth, performance management, and team culture and cohesion. Specifically:

Grow the careers of engineering leaders through structured weekly check-ins, regular career reviews, and clearly differentiated expectations.

Provide technical mentorship and partner with our Principal Engineer and Head of Engineering to sustain a strong technical bench.

Lead recruitment efforts with an explicit preference for African talent, build a globally distributed team, and support the growth of our Technology brand that reflects the communities we serve.

Serve as a leader and role model within the Technology Division, embodying One Acre Fund's core values: Humble Service, Hard Work, Continual Growth, Family of Leaders, Dream Big, and Integrity.

Lead efficient and timely delivery of impactful software products: You will deploy engineering capacity against the most important challenges facing the organisation, with a particular focus on our strategic platforms and the persona-led Experience Teams. Specifically:

Deliver against the outcomes owned by the Experience Teams for Field Officers, Farmers, and Programme Staff.

Scale Farmer360 as the central unified farmer identity and CRM data layer underpinning the rest of the platform estate.

Define and evolve system architecture in partnership with OCTO, participate actively in the CAB and ADR governance forums, and contribute to architectural decision-making at the division level.

Develop and uphold reliability standards (SLOs/SLIs) for critical systems, with mature incident response, post-mortem, and SRE practices.

Champion platform engineering and developer experience as first-class disciplines that compound delivery velocity over time.

Embed flow-based, outcome-led delivery practice across teams; move beyond ceremony-centric Scrum towards continuous delivery and measurable product outcomes.

Communicate and engage with key stakeholders: You will engage with a broad group of stakeholders across the Technology Division and the wider organisation to align priorities and solve problems. Specifically:

Represent engineering in Technology Division leadership forums and in organisation-wide decision-making, and effectively communicate opportunities and risks with senior leadership.

Play a key role in cross-functional working groups (Product, Data, InfoSec, IT Operations, Programme) focused on using technology to advance 1AF's mission.

Communicate business and technology strategy clearly throughout the engineering organisation, ensuring alignment from leadership through to individual contributors.

Ensure compliance, security, and data sovereignty: You will ensure our engineering practice meets the regulatory and security obligations of the markets in which we operate. Specifically:

Partner with the Head of InfoSec to embed security into the SDLC and ensure controls are reflected in design, code, and operations.

Ensure platforms are built and operated in line with East African data sovereignty obligations, including Rwanda Law N° 058/2021 and equivalent emerging frameworks across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Nigeria, and Malawi.

Meet the additional obligations arising from operating credit and payment services at scale across our markets. 

People Management

Approximately 5+ direct reports a team of around 50 people across the following workstreams: 

Experience Team Engineering — Including Field Ops, Farmer, HQ Sys Ops, CorpTech.

DevOps / Site Reliability Engineering (in close partnership with the DevOps lead)

Architecture (in partnership with OCTO)

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

10+ years building software solutions, including 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role with accountability for delivery, hiring and people growth.

Cloud: Deep, hands-on AWS experience. Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading a substantial cloud migration is a bonus.

Engineering practice: proven application of DORA-led engineering health, continuous delivery, SRE / reliability practice, and platform engineering/developer experience as disciplines.

Polyglot stack competence: comfort across modern web (TypeScript / React or equivalent), mobile (Android, offline-first patterns), and backend (Java / Kotlin, Go, Node.js, or Python). We value the ability to evaluate stack choices critically over name-check expertise in any one framework.

Data systems: experience designing and operating both transactional and analytical data stores at scale, and integrating these with a unified data/identity layer.

AI integration: practical experience integrating ML or AI capability into production systems, and partnering with specialist AI / ML teams to do so responsibly.

Delivery model: outcome-led, flow-oriented agile practice; experience scaling delivery across distributed, multi-country teams. Lean/continuous delivery orientation valued over Scrum certifications.

Security and compliance: strong information security instincts; demonstrable experience operating within data sovereignty, financial services, or other regulated contexts.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Nairobi, Kenya; or Kigali, Rwanda (these two locations are preferred, but we are open to locations within our program countries)

Benefits

Application Deadline

07 December 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis, which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across ten countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

Every year, tens of thousands of people apply to work at One Acre Fund. Behind each of those applications is a person waiting to hear back, and behind each open role is a team waiting for the help. Your job is to serve those hiring teams well, which means running your recruitment roles diligently, going out and finding outstanding talent rather than waiting for it to arrive, and placing the right people in the roles that are open.

We are looking for someone with three or more years of experience who has handled a lot of moving pieces at once and kept them all on track. You have owned several workstreams in parallel, and none of them quietly fell apart. You have managed or coordinated other people, set expectations for them, and followed through when those expectations were not met. You are comfortable with senior stakeholders, so you can take a leader's priority, turn it into a plan, keep them updated without being asked, and come back with results. You meet people easily and stay in touch with them, which matters here because finding great candidates is as much outreach as it is screening.

Most importantly, you are a problem-solver who takes feedback well. Our hiring processes change often, and the people who do best at One Acre Fund treat a correction as useful information and adjust quickly.

Experience as a recruiter or talent acquisition specialist is helpful but not essential. We encourage you to apply if your background is in consulting, business development, project management, strategy and operations, or anywhere else you have had to keep many moving parts on track for people who were counting on you.

Responsibilities

You will:

Own 8 to 12 roles at once. Each one can hold hundreds of candidates at any given time, and every one of those candidates deserves a process that runs on schedule and treats them well.

Serve as the business partner to your hiring managers. You will work with leaders across One Acre Fund to understand what they actually need, turn that into a hiring plan with realistic timelines, keep them updated as the search moves, and deliver the right hire for each role.

Go out and find talent. Screening candidates already in the application process is only half the job. You will source proactively for the roles that are hard to fill and build relationships with strong people you will want to call on for future searches.

Manage a small team of recruiters. You will have one to three recruiters reporting to you. That means tracking how they are performing against their goals, giving feedback often enough that nothing comes as a surprise, and mentoring them to get better at the work.

Use the data to make hiring better. You will track candidates from application through to hire in our Applicant Tracking System, spot what is slowing us down, and see improvements through to something that measurably works better than what it replaced.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, we want a professional with at least 4 years of experience, gained ideally in a social enterprise, high-growth, or multi-country environment. Recruiting experience is welcome but not required. Beyond that, you should bring:

Project management experience. You have seen projects through to completion, run several of them at once, and enjoy working in the details.

People management experience. You have managed or coordinated others, set goals for them, tracked how they performed against those goals, and had the difficult conversation when someone fell short.

Stakeholder management experience. You have worked with senior people, turned their priorities into a plan, kept them informed as it progressed, and delivered results back to them.

Proficiency in English is required. French is a bonus.

As soon as possible

One Acre Fund's Countries of Operation

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

2 Years

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of our Countries of Operation.
